bbc3.uk.title: Stacey Dooley - Death in the Barracks
bbc3.uk.description: In 2021, 19-year-old soldier Jaysley Beck was found dead in her army barracks. Through unprecedented access to her family, friends and former colleagues, Stacey Dooley traces her journey from excited young recruit to victim of sexual assault. As her family seeks answers and fights for change, the film explores the experiences of women in the armed forces and asks what more can be done to protect them. (Documentary, Public affairs) - 2026

bbc3.uk.title: Stacey Dooley - Fallen Women
bbc3.uk.description: Stacey Dooley looks into the deaths of women who have fallen from heights, interrogating how these deaths are investigated and exploring whether domestic abuse played a part. (Documentary, Public affairs) - 2026

bbc3.uk.title: Stacey Dooley - Down the K Hole
bbc3.uk.description: Rehab centres are treating some of their youngest-ever and most physically damaged addicts, and ketamine has been their drug of choice. Stacey Dooley gains rare access to a rehab in Stockport and gets to know former users. Many are in chronic pain, and one young man needs bladder reconstruction surgery. Over four months, she follows them through recovery, relationships, setbacks and celebrations. (Documentary, Public affairs) - 2026

bbc3.uk.title: Stacey Dooley: Inside the Undertakers
bbc3.uk.description: Stacey tackles the subject of death by immersing herself in the world of undertaking at a century old funeral director's. This film follows Stacey's previous acclaimed documentary from the same production team behind Inside the Convent, where she expressed her fear of death, seeking answers from the nuns she was staying with, but her curiosity wasn't fully satisfied. Stacey's life has since changed; and as a new mother, her worries for the future and about death have only been exacerbated. (Documentary, Special) - 2023

bbc3.uk.title: Stacey Dooley - Meet the Shoplifters
bbc3.uk.description: In Britain the shoplifting is at an all-time high, incidents of violence and abuse against shop staff have skyrocketed, and a third of Brits have admitted to stealing through the self-checkouts. To understand what's causing this high-street epidemic, Stacey is meeting the people behind the crime and spending time on the shop floor with the staff who deal with shoplifting every day. In Manchester city centre, beauty and cosmetics chain Bodycare has one of its biggest and most shoplifted stores. (Documentary, Public affairs) - 2025

bbc3.uk.title: Stacey Dooley - Growing Up Gypsy
bbc3.uk.description: Stacey heads to Bedfordshire to the private site where 23-year-old Chantelle lives with her husband, Swayley. Chantelle prides herself in keeping with the old Gypsy values her granny Rita taught her and sharing them on social media. (Documentary, Public affairs) - 2025

bbc3.uk.title: Cunk on Earth - The Renaissance Will Not Be Televised
bbc3.uk.description: Continuing her journey through mankind's journey, Cunk visits the allegedly beautiful city of Florence to explore the Renaissance, and she interrogates experts and historians about the revolutions that went on to shape the modern world, including the American War of Independence, and to a lesser extent, the French Revolution. (Comedy) - 2022

bbc3.uk.title: Cunk on Earth - Rise of the Machines
bbc3.uk.description: Cunk continues her ambitious march across the face of mankind into an age of industry and science. With the help of historians, and a science-historian, she explains the scientific breakthroughs of Marie Curie and Albert Einstein. She demonstrates the inventions that changed the world, and covers how the US Civil War, World War I and World War II taught humanity how to use its new grasp of technology to shoot, blow up and irradiate itself in huge numbers. (Comedy) - 2022

bbc3.uk.title: Cunk on Earth - War(s) of the World(s)
bbc3.uk.description: Cunk travels the world and meets top experts to examine the Cold War, the Space Race, Globalisation and Social Media. Recent history is one of polarisation and division as humanity divided itself down the middle: Communism vs Capitalism, Apple vs Microsoft, Beatles vs Stones. (Comedy) - 2022

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Money for Nothing
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S14 E12 In Buckinghamshire, Sarah Moore sifts through boot-fulls of rubbish at Beaconsfield recycling centre in the hope of finding three gems amongst the junk. Lighting designer Duncan McKean takes on a pair of mirrors, while a lacrosse stick and a wrought iron stand test the creative mettle of blacksmiths Bex Simon and Dave Harris. Sarah herself sets to work updating a reproduction desk.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Escape to the Country
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S22 E13 Shropshire (Extended Version) Chris Bavin is in Shropshire, helping a couple find the best properties the county has to offer in their price range. Away from the search, Chris's taste buds are in for a treat when he meets a local chef who uses seasonal local food, much of which he forages himself.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Bidding Room
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S8 E16 Peter Mook Sculpture, Eric Morecambe Blazer, Dean Martin Poster Nigel Havers is shocked by a jaw-dropping sculpture by acclaimed artist Peter Mook, a jacket owned by comedy star Eric Morecambe comes up for sale and the dealers are pushed to sew up a deal on a vintage family favourite.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Bridge of Lies
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S4 E13 Friends Fortune, Xav, Nellie and Kaân compete for cash by crossing a bridge of stepping stones - making sure they avoid the lies. Game show, hosted by Ross Kemp.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Pointless
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S30 E37 Quiz show in which four pairs of contestants have to score the fewest points possible by giving the least obvious answers to questions posed to 100 people before the show. At the end of each round, the team with the most points is eliminated until the final two pairs battle for a cash prize. Presented by Alexander Armstrong and Sally Phillips.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: EastEnders
bbconemidlands.uk.description: E7425 28/10/2026 Jack is forced to come clean to Denise, and the Slaters say goodbye to Zoe, but events don't go as planned, and a revelation comes to light at the wake.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S4 E1 Singer and West End star Sam Ryder, veteran broadcaster Jeff Stelling and Brit Award-winning singer Ella Eyre - each accompanied by a friend or family member - take on the challenge. The line-up is completed by Princess and Junior Andre - the children of Peter Andre and Katie Price - as the four pairs embark on an epic 7,500km race from the prehistoric jungles of Borneo to the sun-baked southern tip of Australia. The competitors cross three countries and two continents, weaving through five checkpoints, before reaching the finish line in Melbourne.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Who Do You Think You Are?
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S17 E3 Ruth Jones Gavin & Stacey co-creator and star Ruth Jones traces her family tree, learning that her paternal grandfather was a leading figure in the Medical Aid Societies of South Wales - which provided a model for the National Health Service in 1948. On her maternal side, she discovers that her great-great-great-grandfather was a mariner who rose to the rank of captain in the domestic coastal trade.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Monkey
bbconemidlands.uk.description: Comedy horror based on a Stephen King story, starring Theo James. In 1999, twin brothers Hal and Bill discover a wind-up toy monkey in their dead father's possessions. When their babysitter is violently killed in a seeming accident, the boys believe the toy is responsible and throw it in a well. Twenty-five years later, Hal's wife dies under horrific circumstances, and he begins to suspect that the monkey is back to wreak more havoc on his life.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Celebrity Inner Circle
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S2 E7 Amanda Holden hosts the quiz show where five contestants each with a celebrity partner and a secret stash of prize money must outsmart each other to win big. Assisting the players this time are Kojey Radical, Max Fosh, Denise Lewis, Stevie Martin and Sara Davies.

bbctwowales.uk.description: Vicki Young presents live coverage of Chancellor John Healey's Budget, including reaction from politicians, experts and members of the public.

bbctwowales.uk.title: Politics Live: Budget 2026
bbctwowales.uk.description: Vicki Young presents live coverage of Chancellor John Healey's Budget, including reaction from politicians, experts and members of the public.

bbctwowales.uk.title: Hawaii: Earth's Tropical Islands
bbctwowales.uk.description: 3/3. A journey across Hawaii's varied islands, discovering how they were made and the incredible wildlife that thrives there, from humpback whales to waterfall-climbing fish. [S,AD]

bbctwowales.uk.title: Antiques Roadshow, Edinburgh
bbctwowales.uk.description: 11/26. Michael Aspel and the team visit Edinburgh where, among the treasures brought to light, they find an ornate Russian cigarette case and a lock of Beethoven's hair.

bbctwowales.uk.title: Flog It!
bbctwowales.uk.description: 40/40. Paul Martin visits Cromer to find out about the RNLI's most decorated lifeboatman.

bbctwowales.uk.title: New: House of Games
bbctwowales.uk.description: 23/95. Les Dennis, Jenny Eclair, Owain Wyn Evans and Lauren Patel test their general knowledge skills on this week's House of Games.

bbctwowales.uk.title: Strictly - It Takes Two
bbctwowales.uk.description: 23/60. Ellie Taylor gets all the news as the celebs prepare for their Halloween-themed dances.

bbctwowales.uk.title: Mortimer and Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
bbctwowales.uk.description: 1/6. Paul and Bob fish the River Ribble in Lancashire and are joined by Ted for the last time. [S,AD]

bbctwowales.uk.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
bbctwowales.uk.description: 1/6. Professor Hannah Fry explores the promises and threats of AI and superintelligence. [S,AD]

bbctwowales.uk.title: The Secret Genius of Modern Life: The Best Bits
bbctwowales.uk.description: 1/6. Hannah Fry takes a look at the bank card, the digital key to accessing cash.

bbctwowales.uk.title: The Repair Shop
bbctwowales.uk.description: 25/25. The Bear Ladies fix a cheeky monkey with royal pedigree, and Lucia repairs a WWII helmet. [S,AD]

bbctwowales.uk.title: Murder in Belfast: Sisters Seeking Justice
bbctwowales.uk.description: 1/3. A stabbing on a street. Scared witnesses. Who will tell Robert's family who killed him? Contains very strong language and disturbing scenes.

bbctwowales.uk.title: Ellie & Natasia
bbctwowales.uk.description: 2/3. Including a game show about snakes, a routine driving lesson that takes a bizarre, surreal turn and an appearance from Asim Chaudhry. Contains some strong language and adult humour.

bbctwowales.uk.title: Newsnight, followed by Weather
bbctwowales.uk.description: Insights and global interviews on the news stories of the day. With Victoria Derbyshire.   Followed by Weather.

bbctwowales.uk.title: Unspun World with John Simpson
bbctwowales.uk.description: Unspun World provides an unvarnished version of the week's major global news stories - reliable, honest and essential viewing with the BBC's world affairs editor, John Simpson.

bbctwowales.uk.title: Escaping Idi Amin
bbctwowales.uk.description: 1/2. Dictator Idi Amin gives all Asians 90 days to leave Uganda. Will they get out in time? Contains scenes which some viewers may find upsetting. [S,AD]

bbctwowales.uk.title: See Hear: Life Between Two Worlds
bbctwowales.uk.description: 11/16. See Hear explores mixed deaf and hearing families, celebrating the importance of sign language, family bonds and sharing experiences across both deaf and hearing worlds. [S,SL]

bbctwowales.uk.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
bbctwowales.uk.description: 3/8. Eva enjoys Bordeaux's world-famous wines with some surprising pairings, while also sampling its fresh caviar, beef and duck served with masterful bordelaise sauces. [S,AD,SL]

bbctwowales.uk.title: This is BBC Two
bbctwowales.uk.description: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

bbctwowales.uk.title: The Bidding Room
bbctwowales.uk.description: 16/25. Nigel is shocked by a jaw-dropping sculpture, the dealers are pushed to sew up a deal on a vintage family favourite, and a jacket owned by a beloved comedy legend is up for sale.

bbctwowales.uk.title: House of Games
bbctwowales.uk.description: 23/95. Les Dennis, Jenny Eclair, Owain Wyn Evans and Lauren Patel test their general knowledge skills on this week's House of Games.

bbctwowales.uk.title: Gardeners' World
bbctwowales.uk.description: Monty is planting spring-flowering bulbs to provide colour in the months ahead. [S,AD,SL]

bbctwowales.uk.title: See Hear: Football for All
bbctwowales.uk.description: 12/16. See Hear explores the world of football, from improving access for deaf fans to the future of deaf football and the inspirational journey of an England deaf futsal champion. [S,SL]

highstreettv5.uk.title: Shed And Buried: Classic Cars

highstreettv5.uk.title: Shed And Buried

highstreettv5.uk.title: Shed And Buried
highstreettv5.uk.description: Dino / Morgan Sports Car. Henry and Fuzz are in West Sussex at Dino's mega-shed. He's got buses, vintage sports cars, rare motorbikes and oodles of motoring ephemera.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Find It, Fix It, Flog It

highstreettv5.uk.description: A recently retired woman wants to declutter her home and raise money to visit her family abroad. Angus travels to Horsforth to dig through her collection.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Sam Lovegrove: Race Mechanic

highstreettv5.uk.title: Shed And Buried

highstreettv5.uk.title: Find It, Fix It, Flog It

highstreettv5.uk.title: The Yorkshire Auction House
highstreettv5.uk.description: The Hunt for Lost Gold. A hunt for lost gold in a Glasgow flat proves a challenge for Angus. He also helps a widow with an emotional downsize.

highstreettv5.uk.title: The Repair Shop

highstreettv5.uk.title: How Do They Do It?
highstreettv5.uk.description: A look at how old concrete is recycled into new roads, the hand tailored suits that are fit for 007 and the ovens that clean themselves.

highstreettv5.uk.title: How Do They Do It?
highstreettv5.uk.description: How do they fabricate fire gloves for emergency services personnel? Plus, how do they create the enamel that is used in bake-wear around the world.

highstreettv5.uk.title: How Do They Do It?
highstreettv5.uk.description: How do the islanders of the Outer Hebrides use pedal power to weave world-famous Harris tweed? And, in Iceland, how do they prepare fermented shark.

highstreettv5.uk.title: How Do They Do It?
highstreettv5.uk.description: How do they make the world's most expensive and luxurious beds? And, how do they deliver supplies and equipment to the International Space Station.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Salvage Hunters
highstreettv5.uk.description: Heritage Heroes. Drew and Al buy from heritage sellers, snapping up a curved oak settle made in 1810, and century-old steel tables from a Northampton blacksmith.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Salvage Hunters
highstreettv5.uk.description: Viki's New Shop. Drew and Viki buy for Viki's new Edinburgh premises. They find deer antlers from a Cumbrian country house and industrial tables from a former tannery.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Salvage Hunters: Classic Cars
highstreettv5.uk.description: Jag And Merc. Drew and Paul unearth a 1968 Mark 11 Jaguar to modify give a race-inspired look. In Yorkshire, they find a rare gold 1970s Mercedes 350 SLC that needs a lot of work.

highstreettv5.uk.title: How It's Made

highstreettv5.uk.title: Salvage Hunters

itv1anglia.uk.description: S3 E5 Liverpool v Chelsea (Kick-off 8.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the fourth-round match at Anfield, as the teams meet in this competition for the first time since the 2023/24 final. A Virgil van Dijk header in the closing minutes of extra time saw the Reds claim a 1-0 victory on that occasion and go on to lift the trophy for the 10th time in their history, which is still the record number of wins for any club in this competition. amc.us.title: Jason X
amc.us.description: The year is 2455. The Place is Old Earth. Once the shimmering blue jewel of the galaxy, Old Earth is now a contaminated planet abandoned for centuries. Yet humans have returned to the deadly place that they once fled. Not to live, but to research the ancient rusting artifacts of the bygone civilizations that caused this environmental disaster. And little does the most recent landing party of intrepid young explorers realize the fate that awaits them. (Horror, Science fiction) - 2002

amc.us.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street 4: The Dream Master
amc.us.description: Grotesque Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund) gives some more suburban teenagers something to dream about. (Horror) - 1988

amc.us.title: Wes Craven's New Nightmare
amc.us.description: Reality and fantasy meet in unsettling ways in this installment of the long-running horror series, which finds director Wes Craven and actors Heather Langenkamp and Robert Englund all portraying themselves. As Heather (Heather Langenkamp) considers making another film with Craven, her son, Dylan (Miko Hughes), falls under the spell of the iconic disfigured villain Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund). Eventually, Langenkamp must confront Freddy's demonic spirit to save the soul of Dylan. (Horror, Fantasy, Mystery) - 1994

amc.us.title: Freddy vs. Jason
amc.us.description: Two horror icons face off in this supernatural movie. Disfigured serial killer Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund), who attacks his victims in their dreams, has lost much of his power since citizens of his town have become less afraid of him. Enlisting the help of fellow violent murderer Jason Voorhees (Ken Kirzinger), Freddy orchestrates a new killing spree. However, when the hockey-mask-wearing psychopath won't stop chopping up Freddy's intended victims, the two ghouls start to battle each other. (Horror) - 2003

amc.us.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street
amc.us.description: In Wes Craven's classic slasher film, several Midwestern teenagers fall prey to Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund), a disfigured midnight mangler who preys on the teenagers in their dreams -- which, in turn, kills them in reality. After investigating the phenomenon, Nancy (Heather Langenkamp) begins to suspect that a dark secret kept by her and her friends' parents may be the key to unraveling the mystery, but can Nancy and her boyfriend Glen (Johnny Depp) solve the puzzle before it's too late? (Horror, Thriller) - 1984

amc.us.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street 2: Freddy's Revenge
amc.us.description: Jesse Walsh (Mark Patton) moves with his family into the home of the lone survivor from a series of attacks by dream-stalking monster Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund). There, Jesse is bedeviled by nightmares and inexplicably violent impulses. It turns out Freddy needs a host body to carry out his gruesome vendetta against the youth of Springwood, Ohio. While Freddy gains influence, Jesse and his girlfriend, Lisa (Kim Myers), race against the clock trying to figure out what's going on. (Horror) - 1985

amc.us.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street 3: Dream Warriors
amc.us.description: During a hallucinatory incident, young Kristen Parker (Patricia Arquette) has her wrists slashed by dream-stalking monster Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund). Her mother, mistaking the wounds for a suicide attempt, sends Kristen to a psychiatric ward, where she joins a group of similarly troubled teens. One of the doctors there is Nancy Thompson (Heather Langenkamp), who had battled Freddy some years before. Nancy senses a potential in Kristen to rid the world of Freddy once and for all. (Horror) - 1987

amc.us.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street
amc.us.description: Teenagers Nancy, Quentin, Kris, Jesse and Dean are all neighborhood friends who begin having the same dream of a horribly disfigured man who wears a tattered sweater and a glove made of knives. The man, Freddy Krueger (Jackie Earle Haley), terrorizes them in their dreams, and the only escape is to wake up. But when one of their number dies violently, the friends realize that what happens in the dream world is real, and the only way to stay alive is to stay awake. (Horror) - 2010

amc.us.title: The Conjuring
amc.us.description: In 1970, paranormal investigators and demonologists Lorraine (Vera Farmiga) and Ed (Patrick Wilson) Warren are summoned to the home of Carolyn (Lili Taylor) and Roger (Ron Livingston) Perron. The Perrons and their five daughters have recently moved into a secluded farmhouse, where a supernatural presence has made itself known. Though the manifestations are relatively benign at first, events soon escalate in horrifying fashion, especially after the Warrens discover the house's macabre history. (Horror, Thriller) - 2013

amc.us.title: The Crazies
amc.us.description: Anarchy reigns when an unknown toxin turns the peaceful citizens of Ogden Marsh into bloodthirsty lunatics. In an effort to contain the spread of the infection, authorities blockade the town and use deadly force to keep anyone from getting in or out. Now trapped among killers, Sheriff Dutton and his wife and two companions must band together to find a way out before madness and death overtake them. (Horror, Thriller) - 2010

amc.us.title: Jeepers Creepers 2
amc.us.description: After his son is set upon by a scarecrow that seems to have come alive, farmer Jack Taggart Sr. (Ray Wise) and his son, Jack Taggart Jr. (Luke Edwards), go looking for an explanation. Meanwhile, a bus carrying high-school students breaks down nearby, and a creature known as the Creeper (Jonathan Breck) starts a killing spree. The elder Taggart soon realizes that the killings and the attack on his son are connected, and, after alerting the community to be on guard, he aims to pummel the Creeper. (Horror, Thriller) - 2003

amc.us.title: Jeepers Creepers
amc.us.description: After making a horrific discovery in the basement of an old abandoned church, Trish (Gina Philips) and her brother Darry (Justin Long) watch their routine road trip home from college turn into a heart-stopping race for their lives. They find themselves the chosen prey of an indestructible force that relentlessly pursues them and gives a new and chilling meaning to the old song "Jeepers Creepers." (Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 2001

amc.us.title: House of Wax
amc.us.description: A gang of college friends, including Wade (Jared Padalecki) and his girlfriend, Carly (Elisha Cuthbert), are en route to a school football game when they wind up with a flat tire in a ghost town. They are forced to seek help in the only place that's open: the local wax museum. Once inside the spooky and seemingly abandoned building, they find the works on display are not quite what they seem -- and the group soon discovers it's being hunted by the insane twin brothers who run the museum. (Horror) - 2005

amc.us.title: Final Destination
amc.us.description: Alex Browning is embarking on a trip to Paris. He experiences a premonition -- he sees the plane explode moments after leaving the ground. Insisting that everyone get off the plane, Alex and seven other people are forced to disembark. All watch as the plane actually explodes in a fireball. He and the other survivors have briefly cheated death, but will not be able to evade their fate for very long. One by one, these fugitives from fate fall victim to the grim reaper. (Horror, Thriller) - 2000

amc.us.title: The Final Destination

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 3: Drive Time
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal teach the setup and swing keys to driving it longer and straighter; Martin reveals how to add more power just by changing your grip; a swing tip from Annika Sorenstam; a lesson on how archery can improve your driving.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 4: Chip It Close
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal teach how to chip it close and save strokes around the green. Martin reveals the short game secrets he picked up working alongside Masters champions Seve Ballesteros, Phil Mickelson, and Raymond Floyd.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 5: Sharpen Your Irons
golfpass.us.description: The School of Golf offers tips and tricks on how to improve your golfing game from tee to green.

golfpass.us.title: Golf Central
golfpass.us.description: Keep up with everything that's happening in the world of golf. The game's only live, daily news source provides more than just scores, delivering in depth analysis, breaking news, and unforgettable highlights.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 6: Make More Putts
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal teach the key fundamentals and drills needed to make more putts. Learn how a yardstick can improve the start direction, how bubble wrap helps judge speed, and how to tip putt boldly like Arnold Palmer.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 7: Practice Like the Pros
golfpass.us.description: The School of Golf offers tips and tricks on how to improve your golfing game. Here, all the ways to make sure you can practice like a pro.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 8: Stop the Slice
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall and Nikki B teach the setup and swing keys for stopping the slice. Learn how to drive for show and dough with drills involving a wallet and a dollar bill. Martin also uses the Wall of Learning to improve the backswing and downswing.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 9: Drive, Chip and Putt
golfpass.us.description: The School of Golf offers tips and tricks on how to improve your golfing game. Here, a look at the key process of perfecting your drive, chip and putt.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 10: Teamwork
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall and Nikki B team up to reveal what to learn from some of golf's other great teams; Davis Love shares a favorite drill he learned from his father; the ball striking breakthrough Bernhard Langer made with his long-time coach.

golfpass.us.title: Ask Rory - Attacking Par 5s
golfpass.us.description: Rory McIlroy explains common amateur mistakes when trying to add distance and his par 5 strategy when going for the green in two.

golfpass.us.title: Ask Rory - Drivable Par 4s
golfpass.us.description: Rory McIlroy answers member-submitted questions about how to swing better, shoot lower scores and have more fun with challenges on the golf course.

golfpass.us.title: Big Break: Where Are They Now? - Isaac Sanchez & Chad Pfeifer
golfpass.us.description: We catch up with former Big Break competitors Isaac Sanchez and Chad Pfeifer. Sanchez, who goes by the nickname "Sasquatch," is in actuality a gentle giant. But that didn't stop the competitor in him from creating some mythical moments.

golfpass.us.title: Big Break: Where Are They Now? - Mallory Blackwelder, Julien Trudeau & Robbie Biershenk
golfpass.us.description: They began as members of opposite teams on Big Break Ireland; Mallory Blackwelder and Julien Trudeau ended as the series' first married couple; in between, Mallory was a standout on Big Break NFL for Team Brown; meet the rest of their new team.

golfpass.us.title: Big Break: Where Are They Now? - Sara Brown & Brian Cooper
golfpass.us.description: Sara Brown graced Golf Channel screens with strong runs at Big Break Sandals and Big Break Dominican Republic; she is running a family, occasionally herding preschoolers and being the ultimate team mom for her husband’s other successful squad.

golfpass.us.title: Build a Better Game - Maximum Distance -- Part 1

mlbnetwork.us.title: Intentional Talk ᴸᶦᵛᵉ

He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. secnetwork.us.description: Veteran writer, reporter and radio personality Paul Finebaum built a legion of loyal sports fans as the "Voice of the SEC" during 20 years hosting his Birmingham, Ala.-based radio talk show. When ESPN launched the SEC Network in 2014, it was only natural that Finebaum became its first on-air hire, bringing his radio show -- and those passionate followers -- with him. Now originating from one of the SEC Network studios in Charlotte, N.C., the show is a forum for lively discussion and debate of all things SEC and across the spectrum of college sports, with Finebaum playing the role of both moderator and provocateur. The show airs weekday afternoons throughout the year on SEC Network. (Sports talk, Interview) - 2013-12-02

oxygen.us.description: With no evidence and no witnesses, detectives must find a murderer when a hero of Atlanta's West End is executed in front of his home, but the community is in disbelief when the killer is finally brought to justice and identified. (Documentary)

oxygen.us.title: The Real Murders of Atlanta - American Nightmare
oxygen.us.description: An African immigrant is found tortured and murdered in his West End home; Atlanta detectives uncover a string of violent crimes tied to a terrifying criminal syndicate that the team must take down to restore peace to the Big Peach. (Documentary)

oxygen.us.title: The Real Murders of Atlanta - House of Horrors
oxygen.us.description: When a young mother of two disappears just a few weeks before Halloween, detectives scour an upscale Atlanta neighborhood for clues, only to uncover a gruesome crime scene that haunts the community to this day. (Documentary)

oxygen.us.title: The Real Murders of Atlanta - Horror at the Mall
oxygen.us.description: A 28-year-old mother vanishes without a trace, only to turn up murdered and left at an Atlanta area mall; when DNA points to a suspect who's never met her, investigators must look beyond the physical evidence to uncover an even deeper mystery. (Documentary)

oxygen.us.title: The Real Murders of Atlanta - Halloween Horror
oxygen.us.description: After a young woman finds a human foot on her porch the night before Halloween, detectives race to identify the scattered remains and uncover a killer who'll do anything to bury the truth. (Documentary)

oxygen.us.title: Cold Justice - House of Horrors (Part 1)
oxygen.us.description: Kelly and Steve team up with the Anderson County Sheriff's Office to solve the horrific quadruple homicide of a family on Halloween; their investigation reveals a family feud, a trail of stolen cash, and a bloody shoe print left by the killer. (Reality TV)

oxygen.us.title: Cold Justice - House of Horrors (Part 2)
oxygen.us.description: The "Cold Justice" team and the Anderson County Sheriff's Office continue their investigation into the quadruple homicide of a family of four in an attempt to finally give answers and justice to their grieving family and community. (Reality TV)

oxygen.us.title: Cold Justice - Horror in the Home
oxygen.us.description: Kelly and Steve Spingola partner once again to work with the Potter County Sheriff's Department in Texas in investigating the brutal murder of a doting mother of four; DNA testing could help them find the murderer. (Reality TV)

oxygen.us.title: Catfish Murders - A Killer Profile
oxygen.us.description: When an Arizona corrections officer vanishes after leaving for a hot date, investigators uncover blood in the desert, a digital phantom named Paige, and a predator lurking in plain sight. (Documentary)

oxygen.us.title: Catfish Murders - A Hopeless Romantic
oxygen.us.description: A young mother, with dreams of settling down, finally finds love online. But her hopes for a romantic Valentine's Day take a terrifying turn when she's lured into a deadly trap, masterminded by a self-styled cult leader. (Documentary)

oxygen.us.title: Snapped: Killer Moms - Kimberly Warth
oxygen.us.description: When Las Vegas Police respond to a self-defense shooting, the case appears open and shut; following the discovery of bombshell video evidence that contradicts the shooter's initial story, a mother's desperation for him. (Documentary)

oxygen.us.title: Snapped: Killer Moms - Cynthia Cdebaca
oxygen.us.description: When a California man is found riddled with bullets in his own home, the investigation leads to an unconventional suspect close to the victim. A bizarre interrogation leaves a daughter heartbroken by the actions her mother took to protect her. (Documentary)

oxygen.us.title: Forensic Files - Lights Out

oxygen.us.title: Forensic Files - Pet Rock

oxygen.us.title: Forensic Files - Best Foot Forward
oxygen.us.description: The search for a missing exotic dancer led police to an isolated 75-acre site where someone had been shot and cremated, thus destroying all evidence... almost; piece of a foot provided enough DNA for a genetic profile and positive ID. (Documentary)

oxygen.us.title: Forensic Files - A Squire's Riches
oxygen.us.description: When a man perishes in a fire while working in his garage, his death is initially ruled an accident until a forensic odontologist changes the direction of the case. (Documentary)

oxygen.us.title: Forensic Files - Home of the Brave
oxygen.us.description: Lack of evidence compels investigators to look beyond the obvious when a woman is beaten to death at her in-laws house. (Documentary)

oxygen.us.title: Forensic Files - Freeze Framed
oxygen.us.description: A man is found dead of an apparent suicide. But soon after, information emerges which reveals a much more menacing scenario. (Documentary)

oxygen.us.title: Forensic Files - Textbook Murder

673498.title: The Last Frontier
673498.description: Jed Cooper (Victor Mature), a trapper, enlists as an army fort scout, and shortly after meets and falls for Corinna Marston (Anne Bancroft), the wife of a nearby fort's commander. Jed comes across her husband, Col. Marston (Robert Preston), after he's suffered an attack at the hands of Native Americans. Col. Marston forces the captain of Jed's fort, Glenn Riordan (Guy Madison), to send out Jed and the troops to fight his attackers, despite their lack of battle experience.

673498.title: White Eagle
673498.description: An Indian pony-express rider catches post-Civil War horse thieves.

673498.title: Prairie Schooners
673498.description: Wild Bill Hickok (Bill Elliott) and his pal (Dub Taylor) take a wagon train through Indian country.

673498.title: Gun Fury
673498.description: California-bound rancher Ben Warren (Rock Hudson) is shot and left for dead when a demented ex-Confederate, Frank Slayton (Phil Carey), kidnaps his Southern bride-to-be (Donna Reed). Revived, Ben sets out to rescue her. Along the way, he picks up Jess Burgess (Leo Gordon), a slighted former member of Slayton's gang, and American Indian local Johash (Pat Hogan), who has his own beef with the outlaws. Together they embark on a perilous chase toward the Mexican border to stop Slayton.

673498.title: Jubal
673498.description: Searching for work, cowboy Jubal Troop (Glenn Ford) arrives in a small town, where he badly injures his hand. Fortunately, a local rancher, Shep Horgan (Ernest Borgnine), is willing to employ Troop despite the injury. Horgan and Troop work together amicably, but Horgan's two-timing wife (Valerie French) threatens to create discord when she becomes interested in Troop, although he really loves another woman. A jealous cowhand (Rod Steiger) complicates matters by spreading lies.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1987, a successful television producer was gunned down in his New York office. It looked like a professional hit. With no leads, the investigation stalled. Four years later and a continent away, a man told Los Angeles police he had been hired to murder two exotic dancers. Investigators linked the two crimes and uncovered a businessman willing to kill to protect his interests.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A 1981 armored car robbery near New York City left one guard dead and another critically wounded. Police stopped suspects nearby and another shoot-out ensued, claiming the lives of two officers. Local police and the FBI suspected a large group of domestic terrorists with a history of violent crime. They would try to ferret out these heavily armed criminals who moved in a shadowy underworld and were not afraid to kill authorities.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: When a California man was found dismembered in 1990, police suspected a local burglar, but they couldn't find him. Six months later, he was caught robbing an Arizona bank and sentenced to life. But prison couldn't hold him for long, and within a year he escaped. The FBI would lead a multi-agency manhunt for a killer on a desperate run through the tourist regions of the west.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: At first it seemed like a tragic hunting accident when 18-year-old David Wilkey was shot to death in rural Virginia in 1983. A tenacious insurance investigator suspected foul play, but he had no direct evidence. Two years later a man contacted North Carolina FBI agents with a complex story of conspiracy and murder-for-hire: he claimed he had been hired to murder Wilkey's killer.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On a summer night in 1990, a body was discovered burning in a Minnesota alley. Weeks later, police finally identified the victim, a suspected drug courier from California. The FBI began working with local police and slowly uncovered a multi-state crime ring run by a deadly drug lord who used violence and intimidation to keep those around him silent. Agents needed to infiltrate and dismantle the crew before more people died.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the early 1990's drug gangs terrorized Harlem, New York neighborhoods. When a 10-year-old boy fell victim in the crossfire, NYPD detectives and FBI agents clamped down on the problem. They formed a task force called C-11, designed to dismantle the gangs. In an environment of violence and fear it would be difficult to identify, arrest and convict those involved in the secretive and deadly world of big money drugs.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1994, a teenage immigrant came to the United States to realize her dream of becoming a doctor. But a tragic twist of fate intervened, when she found herself an innocent victim of the drug trade. Kidnapped and held captive, she survived for days against all odds. Authorities arrested her captors, but they refused to reveal her whereabouts. The FBI and local police raced against time, determined to save the teenager's life. Their investigation revealed a complex story of drugs, betrayal and revenge.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the mid-1990's, a gang of professional bank robbers raided cities across seven states. Disguises and speed protected their identity from cameras and the police as they stole hundreds of thousands of dollars, always leaving a bomb to terrorize their victims. The stakes were raised when the FBI discovered the robbers had an agenda beyond their personal wealth. To stop these extremists and their growing operation, the FBI needed to capture their leaders.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A Labor Day weekend turned into a nightmare of murder as a cross-country crime spree terrorized the nation. In a small Ohio community, an elderly woman and a teenage boy disappeared within hours of each other. Police believed the cases were linked, but didn't know how. They contacted the FBI for help. A trail of stolen vehicles and murder victims across seven states led agents on a hunt for two suspected killers. Their only hope of stopping them was to anticipate the killers' next move.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A day that began with a class field trip ended with a parent's worst nightmare. An 11-year-old girl was missing. Her parents were certain she was no runaway. When they failed to find her in their quiet Illinois neighborhood, they called the police. The FBI soon joined the investigation and family and friends worked with detectives and agents in an urgent search for the missing girl. Faced with conflicting witness reports and false leads, agents wouldn't stop until they found the girl, and the truth.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the summer of 1988, a wealthy Jackson, Mississippi woman disappeared from her home in broad daylight. Left behind was a mysterious ransom note listing twelve names and no specific instructions. The note, and a few drops of blood were the only clues to her fate. FBI and local police struggled to find answers in the cryptic message so they could find the kidnapper and retrieve the victim before her time ran out. Solving the crime required the keen insight of a criminal profiler and the perseverance of a family, local authorities, and the FBI.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Arizona, a shipment of money vanished into the high desert, along with the two men hired to guard it. The FBI didn't know if the guards were participants or victims of an ambush. Answers lay somewhere in the thousands of square miles of Arizona's northwest territory. When the vehicle was recovered with three hundred thousand dollars and the drivers missing, suspicions that the crime was an inside job grew.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Alabama, a pair of convicted felons escaped the custody of a local deputy and fled across the country. Eluding authorities, they moved from state to state in a wave of abduction and car theft. When a foreign military officer disappeared along their trail, police and FBI agents wondered if the armed fugitives had become killers. Agents believed the pair were growing more violent and raced to find the escapees before more victims crossed their path.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1992, a young mother was gunned down in front of her children. Police searched for answers, but found none. The horrible crime appeared unmotivated, senseless, and random. Then, family members offered a startling clue. The victim, the wife of a prominent Atlanta attorney, was also a woman burdened with a secret; a secret the FBI believed led to her death. It would force local and federal agents to untangle an intricate web of money, drugs and murder.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Memphis, Tennessee, a horrible crime terrified local residents. When a wealthy young mother was abducted in front of her in-laws' home, the police had no shortage of suspects. The twenty-five year old victim left behind a tumultuous marriage, an ex-husband, and several spurned boyfriends. All were on the FBI's short list. To find the woman and her abductor, investigators would have to first determine the motive.

700407.title: Monty Don's Japanese Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don returns to Japan during the fiery blaze of autumn. He visits the three great gardens of Japan to learn how they protect the garden from the coming winter and learns how the Japanese are weaving nature into their concrete urban jungle.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty begins in the city of Trieste, close to Italy's border with Croatia, to visit a public garden first created by an obsessive royal plantsman more than 150 years ago, which is now being carefully restored. He then heads down the Adriatic coast through Croatia to pick up the trail that the Venetians followed, ending his journey on the beautiful island of Lopud, near Dubrovnik.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty travels to Europe and explores the influence of the Venetians on gardening. To begin with, he explores Venice on one of the city's famous barges, stepping out to visit green spaces large and small that are often hidden from view behind high walls.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty begins the last leg of his journey in Corfu, a Greek island with strong Venetian links, including olive trees planted by them that are still grown today. Here, Monty visits a spectacular garden made by an Englishman with Greek connections.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty propagates succulent plants, revisits his container vegetable garden, and gives advice on how to get a good crop of pumpkins. Adam looks a new garden at RHS Hyde Hall in Essex, and Rachel visits a garden of vibrant colours in Wiltshire.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Adam Frost is in his garden, bringing viewers up to date on how it has been developing, as well as giving advice on growing hydrangeas. Toby Buckland shares his tips on dealing with damaged shrubs, tree pruning and transplanting perennials.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty refreshes a container of overgrown herbs, plants alpines and revisits the shrub and perennial cuttings he took a few weeks ago. Arit Anderson meets a designer who is placing sustainability and the environment at the heart of her gardens.

700407.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
700407.description: One couple battle to turn a clay-clogged building site in Sussex into a piece of Portugal. Another tackle a forest of overgrowth in their new back garden in Cadeby. They are determined to create a productive space, something they have always wanted.

700407.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
700407.description: A truck driver from Wakefield with a passion for flowers wants to create a perfect outside space for his girlfriend and burgeoning family, while in Swindon a widow wants to find the best way of turning her bleak patch of green into a cottage garden.

700407.title: The Secret History of the British Garden
700407.description: Starting his journey at the sole surviving garden of the 1600s, Levens Hall in Cumbria, Monty sets out to investigate what the gardens of this age would have looked like and what influenced and inspired their creation.

700407.title: The Secret History of the British Garden
700407.description: Monty bases himself at Rousham House in Oxfordshire, designed by one of the first practitioners of the landscape movement, William Kent. It has survived almost unchanged since its completion in 1741.

700407.title: The Secret History of the British Garden
700407.description: Monty Don explores the extraordinary transformations that occurred throughout the 19th century. As a result of an expanding empire, scientific and technological innovation and social change, British gardens became more exotic, more colourful and more widely accessible than ever before.

700407.title: The Secret History of the British Garden
700407.description: Monty Don concludes his journey through Britain's gardening heritage by looking at how the nation's gardens have evolved over the last hundred years. He looks at the profound effect that two world wars had on the attitude to gardens and gardening.

actionmax.us.title: Ricochet
actionmax.us.description: After tracking down and arresting Earl Talbot Blake (John Lithgow), a psychotic hit man, rookie Los Angeles police officer Nick Styles (Denzel Washington) is hailed as a hero. Several years later, Styles' life appears perfect: He has married his girlfriend, started a family and risen to the position of assistant district attorney. However, his world is turned upside down when Blake escapes from prison with plans to exact brutal and well-calculated revenge. (Action) - 1991

actionmax.us.title: All Eyez on Me
actionmax.us.description: The true and untold story of prolific rapper, actor, poet and activist Tupac Shakur (Demetrius Shipp Jr.), from his early days in New York to his status as one of the world's most recognized and influential voices. Against all odds, Shakur's raw talent, powerful lyrics and revolutionary mindset establish him as a cultural icon whose legacy continues to grow long after his death. (Biography, Drama, Music, Hip-Hop & rap) - 2017

actionmax.us.title: A History of Violence
actionmax.us.description: When a pair of petty criminals attempt to rob his small-town diner, Tom Stall (Viggo Mortensen) quickly and easily kills them both. In the flush of news coverage of Tom's seemingly heroic actions, a threatening stranger named Carl Fogarty (Ed Harris) comes to town, fingering the unassuming family man as long-missing Philadelphia mobster Joey Cusack. To the horror of his wife, Edie (Maria Bello), and teenage son, Jack (Ashton Holmes), Tom finds he must confront his violent past. (Drama, Thriller) - 2005

actionmax.us.title: Chasing Mavericks
actionmax.us.description: When 15-year-old surfing phenomenon Jay Moriarty discovers that the mythic Mavericks surf break, one of the biggest waves on Earth, actually exists near his California home, he becomes determined to conquer it. Jay enlists the aid of local surfing legend Frosty Hesson to train him to ride the Mavericks and live to tell about it. As Jay and Frosty carry on their quest to achieve the impossible, they develop a unique friendship that transforms both their lives. (Docudrama, Adventure) - 2012

actionmax.us.title: The Rover
actionmax.us.description: In the near future, mankind's greed and excesses have pushed civilization to the breaking point. Society is in decline, and the rule of law has disintegrated. Hardened drifter Eric (Guy Pearce) wanders across this dangerous and desolate landscape. When thieves steal Eric's car -- and only remaining possession -- they leave behind Rey (Robert Pattinson), a wounded comrade. Eric forces Rey to help him hunt down the gang in an unrelenting quest to take back the one thing that matters to him. (Drama, Thriller) - 2014

actionmax.us.title: Ocean's 11
actionmax.us.description: Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies -- including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) -- to pull off an elaborate New Year's Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money. (Comedy drama) - 1960

actionmax.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
actionmax.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2001

actionmax.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
actionmax.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2004

actionmax.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
actionmax.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2007

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S01 E02 The First Taste Bill returns Sookie's favor by rescuing her from the Rattrays' revenge; Bill fights off his primal vampire urges.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S01 E03 Mine Vampires Malcolm, Liam and Diane make a hasty retreat after Bill lays claim to Sookie; Tara seeks respite from her mother's rage; Jason turns to Lafayette for help.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S01 E04 Escape From Dragon House Jason is taken into police custody again; Sookie is urged by Gran to use her telepathic abilities to exonerate her brother; Bill takes Sookie to a vampire bar in Shreveport.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S01 E05 Sparks Fly Out Bill wins over Adele's church group with his vivid recollections from the Civil War; Sam reveals his feelings to Sookie; Jason gives vampire blood another shot.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S01 E06 Cold Ground Sookie seeks refuge from her friends' and neighbors' inner voices; Jason wrestles with withdrawal symptoms; Tara's mother needs her help; Sam and Tara make a connection.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S01 E07 Burning House of Love Sookie's painful childhood revelation spurs Bill into action; Tara agrees to pay for an exorcism for Lettie Mae; Jason travels to Fangtasia in search of V juice.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S01 E08 The Fourth Man in the Fire Sookie tries to hold herself together in the wake of another possible tragedy; Tara lashes out at Sookie and Sam; Amy charms the crowd at Merlotte's.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S01 E09 Plaisir D'Amour Bill must pay a steep price for protecting Sookie; Jason and Amy break a taboo; Tara consults with Miss Jeanette about exorcising her inner demon; Bill enlists an unlikely bodyguard.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S01 E10 I Don't Wanna Know Sam shares a secret with Sookie; Lettie Mae and Tara celebrate; Jason and Amy debate what to do with Eddie; Bill faces a harsh penalty.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S01 E11 To Love Is to Bury Sookie and Sam investigate her most recent vision; Jason helps clean up Amy's mess; Tara becomes angry with Lettie Mae; Lafayette visits a senator.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S01 E12 You'll Be the Death of Me Sookie finds a link to the string of killings in Bon Temps; Tara wants to make the most of her second chance; Jason finds a new calling; Bill tempts fate; Sam is upset by an encounter with an old acquaintance.

hbodrama.us.description: S02 E01 Nothing But the Blood A shocking murder outside Merlotte's bar has the people of Bon Temps reeling; Sookie and Bill's relationship is tested; Sam recalls an encounter he had with Maryann as a 17-year-old.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S02 E04 Shake and Fingerpop Bill and Sookie travel to Dallas to carry out Eric's mission; Jason falls victim to a practical joke; Maryann throws a birthday party for Tara.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S02 E05 Never Let Me Go While in Dallas, Sookie connects with one of her own; Jason is rewarded for his hard work at the Light of Day boot camp; Eric shares a secret about his past with Bill.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S02 E06 Hard-Hearted Hannah Sookie embarks on a dangerous mission to locate Godric; Bill is shocked when a vampire from his past resurfaces in Dallas; Jason must make difficult emotional and physical choices.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S02 E07 Release Me Maryann and her minions put Sam in a difficult situation; Sookie uses her telepathic powers to reach out to Bill; Jason tries to sever his ties with the Fellowship of the Sun.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood

nick.uk.title: Sonic Prime - Nine's Lives
nick.uk.description: Sonic must learn to give up some control if he's going to defeat Nine on the battlefield; the first step is letting the team take over.

nick.uk.title: The Boss Baby: Back in Business - Escape From Krinkle's
nick.uk.description: Boss Baby has an interview at Baby Corp, but he has to break out of a high-tech Bubbeezee playroom first; the field team strives to help him escape.

nick.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Home Away From Home; SpongeBob SpareParts
nick.uk.description: The houses on Conch Street come alive and go on an adventure to save Patrick's rock; Sandy upgrades SpongeBob with robotic parts after he injures his patty-flipping arm.

nick.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Lady in the Lighthouse; Bitter Groans and Gardens
nick.uk.description: Squidward must figure out whodunit after a mysterious stranger vandalizes Mrs. Puff's Boating School; Squidward enters a gardening competition but struggles to keep up with SpongeBob's naturally green thumb.

nick.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show - Dad Election;Supermarket Stars
nick.uk.description: After Patrick learns about Dad Privileges, Patrick and Cecil compete in a Dad Election; The Star family takes over the grocery store.

nick.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show - Witless for the Prosecution; Time for the News
nick.uk.description: SpongeBob represents Patrick in Kid Court; Perch travels through time to cover historical events.

nick.uk.title: Wylde Pak - Meats of Strength; Dead Ed's
nick.uk.description: Jack's new friend Beef invites him to a sleepover; Jack, a sleepover newbie, freaks out over impressing his new friend; Jack and Lil try to prove they're the one true local, enduring a series of bizarre quests in the local dive.

nick.uk.title: Sonic Prime - Dome Sweet Dome
nick.uk.description: To get help in the fight against Nine and his winged lackeys, Sonic heads to New Yoke and forms an allegiance with the very last people he ever expected.

nick.uk.title: Rock Paper Scissors - Trash
nick.uk.description: When Scissors neglects to take out the rubbish, a medieval kingdom of living rubbish takes over the flat; Paper tries to make Scissors do his one chore while Rock looks for the perfect fantasy romance.

nick.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Lady in the Lighthouse; Bitter Groans and Gardens
nick.uk.description: Squidward must figure out whodunit after a mysterious stranger vandalizes Mrs. Puff's Boating School; Squidward enters a gardening competition but struggles to keep up with SpongeBob's naturally green thumb.

nick.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Curse of the WereDoodle; Gorilla Suit Day
nick.uk.description: DoodleBob bites SpongeBob, transforming him into a WereDoodle; SpongeBob dresses up for Gorilla Suit Day and is mistaken for a real gorilla.

nick.uk.title: The Loud House - The Kanga-ruse; The Walking Bed
nick.uk.description: The school mascot is framed for a crime they did not commit. Lincoln finds ways to break a family rule about hand-me-downs.

nick.uk.title: Wylde Pak - The Real Woori World; The Collector
nick.uk.description: Min tries to avoid the usual Woori World chaos, but when the family splits up they all get lost in their own fiascos. Jack's mission to find the rare DVD sequel of his favourite movie leads him to the mysterious Collector.

nick.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show - Squ-AD-ina / Don't Friend the Reaper
nick.uk.description: Squidina and SpongeBob shoot advertisements to fund the Patrick Show. GrandPat takes over Death's job for a day.

nick.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - My Tighty Whiteys; What Ever Happened to Baby Prunes?
nick.uk.description: SpongeBob goes on a desperate search after his favourite pair of underwear go missing; Baby Prunes shares the story of her days as a child star to explain why she despises chocolate.

nick.uk.title: The Boss Baby: Back in Business - Escape From Krinkle's
nick.uk.description: Boss Baby has an interview at Baby Corp, but he has to break out of a high-tech Bubbeezee playroom first; the field team strives to help him escape.

nick.uk.title: Popularity Papers - Skate Expectations
nick.uk.description: Lydia gets mesmerised when she sees Chuck skate at school and decides to become a skateboarder to gain popularity points as a professional athlete, and if it impresses Chuck, that's cool, too.

nick.uk.title: Rock Island Mysteries - Mystery Hunter
nick.uk.description: When an inexplicable noise shocks Rock Island, Taylor and the gang search for its source. In their investigation, they come across a girl claiming to be Lila's biggest fan.

nick.uk.title: Rock Island Mysteries - Frozen In Time
nick.uk.description: During Gillian and Faraz's party on Rock Island, Taylor and their friends realise that everyone else is frozen in time, leaving only them unaffected.

nick.uk.title: Hunter Street - Brainwooshed
nick.uk.description: With time against them, Anika and Jasmyn rush to Orphans Inc hoping to rescue Daniel and the Jacksons, while Jennie and Josh sneak into the Academy to try and find more evidence; Evie has her own battles at home looking after the adults.

nick.uk.title: Hunter Street - Testing Times
nick.uk.description: Oliver's loyalties are tested as Miss Lucas manipulates him and danger befalls Daniel. Jennie finds out some background on Miss Lucas and her bitter grudge against Erik.

nick.uk.title: House of Anubis - House of Suspicion
nick.uk.description: Willow discovers she's related to Joy and saves the day when she inadvertently provides the clue to a missing artefact. KT decides to run away, leaving Victor without his precious sinner. Fabian learns the truth about Patricia.

nick.uk.title: House of Anubis - House of Capture
nick.uk.description: When Fabian's trusting nature lands him in the hands of Frobisher, Ammut's collection is almost complete. Eddie realises the Sibuna traitor is not KT and Jerome shocks Joy with a surprise ending to their play.

nick.uk.title: Henry Danger - Double-O Danger
nick.uk.description: Kid Danger and Captain Man attempt to capture Mob Boss Rob Moss by infiltrating his daughter's sweet sixteen birthday party.

nick.uk.title: Henry Danger - Massage Chair
nick.uk.description: When Captain Man shows up with a cool new massage chair, Henry, Charlotte, and Jasper compete in a series of physical and mental challenges to see who wins the chair.

nick.uk.title: Popularity Papers - Personality Test
nick.uk.description: Lydia and Julie take a personality test to determine if they truly have the personality to be highly popular people.

nick.uk.title: Rock Island Mysteries - A Tale of Two Taylors
nick.uk.description: Taylor accidentally creates a clone of herself, who ends up causing a lot of trouble.

nick.uk.title: Rock Island Mysteries - The Shadow
nick.uk.description: Taylor follows a mysterious shadow to a top-secret section of the Institute after a mysterious meteorite hits Rock Island. The rest of the boys attempt to investigate other strange occurrences.

nick.uk.title: Hunter Street - Lost in the Woods
nick.uk.description: Sal and Anika discover a mysterious stone near the house. Determined to find out more, they head into the forest in search of clues, only to realize they are not alone.

nick.uk.title: Hunter Street - Oliver
nick.uk.description: Sal and Anika meet a nervous boy in the forest who reveals a secret they never would have expected.

nick.uk.title: House of Anubis - House of Chance
nick.uk.description: Nina and Fabian puzzle over the mysterious cube that they found in the tunnels, but it falls into the wrong hands and soon Jasper steals it for the Collector.

nick.uk.title: House of Anubis - House of Divides
nick.uk.description: Nina figures out how to make the mysterious cube into a key to unlock the first door in the tunnels, and soon the Sibunas face their next task filled with deadly booby traps.

nick.uk.title: House of Anubis - House of Crushes
nick.uk.description: The Sibunas' next Task is a deadly Egyptian version of hopscotch. If they get the sequences wrong then the ceiling starts to descend.

nick.uk.title: House of Anubis - House of Vertigo
nick.uk.description: The gang figures out the safe sequence to cross the deadly hopscotch. Then, when Nina hears Senkhara calling, she follows - but is she walking into a trap?

nick.uk.title: Henry Danger - Visible Brad
nick.uk.description: Captain Man and Kid Danger are going to need a little bit of magic and some help from an old friend if they want to catch a thief.

nick.uk.title: Henry Danger - Mr. Nice Guy
nick.uk.description: A vigilante in a smiley-face mask punishes Swellviewians for being rude in public. Kid Danger and Captain Man's investigation leads them to the TV set of Mr. Wallabee, a local TV celebrity who hosts a show for children.

nick.uk.title: Rock Island Mysteries - Something Else In The Water
nick.uk.description: The gang come across an old perfume bottle amidst some buried treasure, which causes Taylor and Lila to age. While they try to reverse the perfume's effects, the South Section steal the bottle.

nick.uk.title: Rock Island Mysteries - Dream a Little Dream
nick.uk.description: At a sleepover, Taylor dreams that Uncle Charlie is in danger and trying to contact her. Soon she discovers her friends are sharing the same dream.

nick.uk.title: The Marsupilamis - Runaway Hope / Bring me the head of Professor Lopez
nick.uk.description: Hope's in a runaway bouncy ball in 'Runaway Hope', then in 'Bring me the head of Professor Lopez', a statue is broken, but by whom?

mgmplus.us.title: Rio Lobo
mgmplus.us.description: Union leader Cord McNally is protecting a routine gold shipment when his troops are attacked by Confederate forces. Not only does he lose the gold, but one of his strongest officers is killed in the raid. At the end of the Civil War, McNally learns that the raiders had help from the inside, and he vows to uncover the two traitors. After a chance encounter with one of the turncoats, McNally travels to the town of Rio Lobo and makes an unexpected discovery. (Western) - 1970

mgmplus.us.title: Vera Cruz
mgmplus.us.description: Following the American Civil War, veteran Benjamin Trane (Gary Cooper) and gunslinger Joe Erin (Burt Lancaster) are just two of many men who head to Mexico as mercenaries. When Emperor Maximilian (George Macready) recruits their services, they reluctantly work together, since the price is right. Trane and Erin are to escort Countess Marie Duvarre (Denise Darcel) to Veracruz -- but when they find a wealth of gold hidden in the stagecoach, the original plan no longer applies. (Western, Adventure, Drama) - 1954

mgmplus.us.title: Betrayed
mgmplus.us.description: Following the murder of a radio personality in Chicago, all evidence of the crime points to a white supremacist group from Iowa. With the FBI on the case, the department sends inexperienced agent Catherine Weaver (Debra Winger) on an undercover mission to root out the killers. Falling for her guise, local farmer and suspect Gary Simmons (Tom Berenger) fully embraces Weaver into the community. As Weaver spends more time with Simmons, her belief in his guilt diminishes and love takes its place. (Thriller) - 1988

mgmplus.us.title: Mystic Pizza
mgmplus.us.description: For sexy Daisy Araujo, her sensible sister Kat and their wisecracking friend Jojo, the summer after high school is a summer they can never forget. Slinging pizza at a local restaurant, the three girls share their hopes, dreams and plans for escaping their small town. (Romantic comedy) - 1988

mgmplus.us.title: Baby Boom
mgmplus.us.description: J.C. Wiatt is a New York City businesswoman who is married to her job and has a relationship with Steven, a successful investment broker. J.C.'s life takes an unexpected turn when a relative suddenly dies and makes her the caretaker of a baby girl. Soon, the baby's arrival causes J.C. to lose first Steven, and then her job. She moves to Vermont and embarks on a series of life-changing events. But when offered the opportunity, will she return to her corporate ways? (Comedy drama, Romance) - 1987

mgmplus.us.title: Overboard
mgmplus.us.description: Kate is a single, working-class mother of three who's hired to clean a luxury yacht that belongs to Leonardo -- a selfish, spoiled and wealthy Mexican playboy. After unjustly firing Kate, Leonardo falls off the boat and wakes up with no memory of who he is. To get payback, Kate shows up at the hospital and convinces the confused amnesiac that they're married. As Leonardo tries to get used to manual labor and his new family, Kate starts to wonder how long she can keep fooling her fake husband. (Romantic comedy) - 2018

mgmplus.us.title: Sabrina
mgmplus.us.description: Sabrina Fairchild is a chauffeur's daughter who grew up with the wealthy Larrabee family. She always had unreciprocated feelings for David, the family's younger son and playboy. But after returning from Paris, Sabrina has become a glamorous woman who gets David's attention. His older, work-minded brother Linus thinks their courtship is bad for the family business and tries to break them up -- but then he starts to fall for her too. (Romantic comedy, Drama) - 1995

mgmplus.us.title: Boomerang
mgmplus.us.description: A cocky ad executive, Marcus (Eddie Murphy) has a reputation as a ladies' man. However, Marcus gets a taste of his own medicine when a merger finds him working under the beautiful Jacqueline (Robin Givens), who has a similarly cavalier attitude about romance. Marcus and Jacqueline become involved, but he is put off by her noncommittal approach to their relationship. Meanwhile, Marcus also begins to develop feelings for the pretty Angela (Halle Berry), who is more thoughtful than Jacqueline. (Romantic comedy) - 1992

mgmplus.us.title: Failure to Launch
mgmplus.us.description: A young man (Matthew McConaughey) continues to live at the home of parents who, in desperation to push him out of the nest once and for all, hatch a plan. They hire a beautiful woman (Sarah Jessica Parker) to entice him to assume the mantle of responsibility and get his own place. (Romantic comedy, Comedy, Romance) - 2006

mgmplus.us.title: Book Club
mgmplus.us.description: Four friends' lives are turned upside down when their book club tackles the infamous "50 Shades of Grey." From discovering new romance to rekindling old flames, they inspire each other to make their next chapter the best chapter. (Romantic comedy) - 2018

mgmplus.us.title: The First Wives Club
mgmplus.us.description: Despondent over the marriage of her ex-husband to a younger woman, a middle-aged divorcée plunges to her death from her penthouse. At the woman's funeral, her former college friends (Bette Midler, Goldie Hawn, Diane Keaton) reunite for the first time in nearly 30 years. When the three discover the reason for their friend's suicide, they realize that all of their ex-husbands have taken them for granted -- and deciding it's time for revenge, they make a pact to get back at their exes. (Comedy) - 1996

mgmplus.us.title: Moonstruck
mgmplus.us.description: No sooner does Italian-American widow Loretta (Cher) accept a marriage proposal from her doltish boyfriend, Johnny (Danny Aiello), than she finds herself falling for his younger brother, Ronny (Nicolas Cage). She tries to resist, but Ronny lost his hand in an accident he blames on his brother, and has no scruples about aggressively pursuing her while Johnny is out of the country. As Loretta falls deeper in love, she comes to learn that she's not the only one in her family with a secret romance. (Romantic comedy, Drama) - 1987

mgmplus.us.title: Unprotected Sets - Daniel Webb
mgmplus.us.description: Comic Daniel Webb gives his unique take on being an empowered gay man in the heart of Texas. (Reality, Standup, Comedy) - 2018-10-19

mgmplus.us.description: Onboard the Hispaniola, Bess targets Graham for protection as Long John lays the groundwork for mutiny with the crew; when violence erupts, Jim makes a calculated move that shifts the balance, tipping the scales in Long John's favor. (Adventure) - 2026-10-18

mgmplus.us.title: Hoodlum
mgmplus.us.description: Having just been released from jail, Bumpy Johnson (Laurence Fishburne) returns to his criminal ways as a linchpin in the African-American-run numbers racket. However, Bumpy's longtime friend Illinois Gordon (Chi McBride) and girlfriend Francine Hughes (Vanessa Williams) are both eager to get him back on the straight and narrow. But a brewing rivalry with Mafia boss Lucky Luciano (Andy Garcia) and his henchman Dutch Schultz (Tim Roth) threatens to raise the stakes to dangerous new levels. (Crime drama) - 1997

mgmplus.us.title: The Package
mgmplus.us.description: Army Sgt. Johnny Gallagher (Gene Hackman) is reassigned after he angers Col. Glen Whitacre (John Heard) at a meeting of American and U.S.S.R. military types. Gallagher's new job is to shepherd detainee Thomas Boyette (Tommy Lee Jones) from Europe to the U.S. But when Gallagher loses track of his prisoner, he asks his ex-wife, a servicewoman with access to Boyette's background data, for help. As the chase leads Gallagher to Chicago, the intrigue ramps up in a way he couldn't have imagined. (Thriller) - 1989

mgmplus.us.title: Breakdown
mgmplus.us.description: While traveling to California, Taylor and his wife, Amy, experience a vehicle malfunction on a remote highway. Amy Taylor accepts a ride from a truck driver to seek assistance while Jeff Taylor remains with the vehicle. When the couple fails to reunite at a designated location, Jeff Taylor begins a search for his wife despite a lack of assistance from local residents or law enforcement. (Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama, Action, Adventure) - 1997

mgmplus.us.title: Colors
mgmplus.us.description: In this gritty police drama from director Dennis Hopper, street-wise cop Bob Hodges (Robert Duvall) and hotheaded rookie Danny McGavin (Sean Penn) grapple with their new partnership on the gang-ridden streets of Los Angeles. Although Danny finally lets Hodges show him the ropes, his adrenaline-fed brutality earns him a reputation with the very gangs they want to help. With a gang war ready to explode, Danny confronts his own racism even as he falls in love with Louisa (Maria Conchita Alonso). (Crime drama, Action) - 1988

mgmplus.us.title: Preparation for the Next Life
mgmplus.us.description: A Uyghur woman moves to New York City where she finds herself laboring in Chinatown's underground kitchens. She fatefully encounters Skinner, a young American soldier who's just returned from three tours in the Middle East. As they start to fall in love, they discover the possibility of a better life together than the ones they believed they were destined to live alone. (Romance, Drama) - 2025

mgmplus.us.title: Wonder
mgmplus.us.description: Born with facial differences that, up until now, have prevented him from going to a mainstream school, Auggie Pullman becomes the most unlikely of heroes when he enters the local fifth grade. As his family, his new classmates, and the larger community all struggle to discover their compassion and acceptance, Auggie's extraordinary journey will unite them and prove you can't blend in when you were born to stand out. (Drama) - 2017
