5starmax.us.title: Son of Godzilla
5starmax.us.description: In this Japanese monster movie, the massive Godzilla comes to the aid of his newborn son, who hatches from an egg on a remote island where scientists are conducting experiments with radioactivity. Revealing a surprising paternal streak, Godzilla tries to teach his much smaller progeny how to use his powers. The father/son team must then battle giant insects, including praying mantises and a formidable spider. Can Godzilla protect his curious tyke from the gargantuan bugs? (Science fiction) - 1967

5starmax.us.title: Batman
5starmax.us.description: Having witnessed his parents' brutal murder as a child, millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne (Michael Keaton) fights crime in Gotham City disguised as Batman, a costumed hero who strikes fear into the hearts of villains. But when a deformed madman who calls himself The Joker (Jack Nicholson) seizes control of Gotham's criminal underworld, Batman must face his most ruthless nemesis ever while protecting both his identity and his love interest, reporter Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1989

5starmax.us.title: Batman Returns
5starmax.us.description: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1992

5starmax.us.title: Batman Forever
5starmax.us.description: Batman (Val Kilmer) faces off against two foes: the schizophrenic, horribly scarred former District Attorney Harvey Dent, aka Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones), and the Riddler (Jim Carrey), a disgruntled ex-Wayne Enterprises inventor seeking revenge against his former employer by unleashing his brain-sucking weapon on Gotham City's residents. As the caped crusader also deals with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian (Nicole Kidman). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1995

5starmax.us.title: Batman & Robin
5starmax.us.description: This superhero adventure finds Batman (George Clooney) and his partner, Robin (Chris O'Donnell), attempting to the foil the sinister schemes of a deranged set of new villains, most notably the melancholy Mr. Freeze (Arnold Schwarzenegger), who wants to make Gotham into an arctic region, and the sultry Poison Ivy (Uma Thurman), a plant-loving femme fatale. As the Dynamic Duo contends with these bad guys, a third hero, Batgirl (Alicia Silverstone), joins the ranks of the city's crime-fighters. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1997

5starmax.us.title: Despicable Me
5starmax.us.description: Supervillain Gru, a man who delights in all things wicked, hatches a plan to steal the moon. Surrounded by an army of little yellow minions and his impenetrable arsenal of weapons and war machines, Gru prepares to vanquish all who stand in his way. However, nothing in his calculations and groundwork has prepared him for his greatest challenge: three adorable orphan girls who want to make him their dad. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: The Hangover Part II
5starmax.us.description: Two years after the disastrous events in Las Vegas, it is now Stu's (Ed Helms) turn to walk down the aisle. Since his bride is from Thailand, Stu decides to hold the wedding there. Desperately hoping to avoid the mayhem of Doug's (Justin Bartha) bachelor party, Stu chooses what he thinks will be a safe option: an alcohol-free, pre-wedding brunch. But this being Thailand, and with Phil (Bradley Cooper) and Alan (Zach Galifianakis) again in attendance, anything can happen. (Comedy) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: The Man
5starmax.us.description: Seeking the gunrunners who killed his partner, undercover cop Derrick Vann sets up a sting. He arranges to meet an arms dealer at a diner, where he'll be the only one reading USA Today. But dentist Andy Fiddler, who's in Detroit for a conference, is there reading the same paper, and the dealer mistakes him for Vann and sets up the deal. When Vann realizes this, he drags the baffled Andy into the operation, forcing him to pose as the fake buyer. (Comedy, Action) - 2005

5starmax.us.title: Catfish
5starmax.us.description: When Nev Shulman, a New York photographer, receives a Facebook request from a child named Abby, he cannot guess the unusual odyssey on which he will soon embark. Abby sends Nev an unusually skilled painting based on one of his photos. Intrigued, he begins online relationships with the rest of Abby's family, including her older sister, Megan. Though troubling inconsistencies soon emerge, Nev continues his online flirtation with Megan, resulting in a road trip to meet her in person. (Documentary, Drama, Mystery) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Sweet Dreams
5starmax.us.description: Aspiring country singer Patsy Cline (Jessica Lange) is resigned to both her thankless gigs and her unhappy marriage, until she meets the charismatic Charlie Dick (Ed Harris). Eventually leaving her husband to marry Charlie, Patsy temporarily shelves her performing career to be a mother. Later she returns to singing and finds success under manager Randy Hughes (David Clennon). Patsy hits a remarkable stride with a string of hit singles, and has become a full-fledged star when tragedy strikes. (Biography) - 1985

5starmax.us.title: Godzilla Raids Again
5starmax.us.description: Prehistoric monsters Godzilla and Anguirus battle it out in Osaka, Japan. (Science fiction) - 1955

5starmax.us.title: The Player
5starmax.us.description: Certain that the anonymous threats he's been receiving are the work of David Kahane (Vincent D'Onofrio), producer Griffin Mill (Tim Robbins) tries to fix things over cocktails. Instead, Griffin ends up murdering the screenwriter and courting the dead man's girlfriend (Greta Scacchi). As police investigate, Griffin concentrates on a prestigious film that might reinvigorate his career. But he soon learns that David's demise hasn't been forgotten by everyone in Hollywood. (Comedy) - 1992

5starmax.us.title: Ricochet
5starmax.us.description: After tracking down and arresting Earl Talbot Blake (John Lithgow), a psychotic hit man, rookie Los Angeles police officer Nick Styles (Denzel Washington) is hailed as a hero. Several years later, Styles' life appears perfect: He has married his girlfriend, started a family and risen to the position of assistant district attorney. However, his world is turned upside down when Blake escapes from prison with plans to exact brutal and well-calculated revenge. (Action) - 1991

5starmax.us.title: Walk the Line
5starmax.us.description: The rise of country music legend Johnny Cash (Joaquin Phoenix) begins with his days as a boy growing up on the family farm, where he struggles under the scorn of his father (Robert Patrick). As the years pass, Cash ends up in Memphis, Tenn., with his wife, Vivian (Ginnifer Goodwin), and breaks into the music scene after finding his trademark sound. While on tour, Cash meets the love of his life, singer June Carter (Reese Witherspoon), but Cash's volatile lifestyle threatens to keep them apart. (Biography, Historical drama, Music, Country, Rock) - 2005

5starmax.us.title: Get Him to the Greek
5starmax.us.description: An ambitious executive at a record company, Aaron Green (Jonah Hill) gets what looks like an easy assignment: He must escort British rock legend Aldous Snow (Russell Brand) to L.A.'s Greek Theatre for the first stop on a lucrative comeback-concert tour. Snow, however, has different plans. Learning his true love is in California, the rocker vows to win her back before starting the tour, forcing Aaron to pull out all the stops to get Snow on stage in time. (Comedy) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: The Blair Witch Project
5starmax.us.description: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises. (Horror, Thriller) - 1999

5starmax.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
5starmax.us.description: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain. (Adventure, Fantasy, Horror) - 2000

5starmax.us.title: Open Water
5starmax.us.description: Daniel (Daniel Travis) and Susan (Blanchard Ryan) embark on a tropical vacation with their scuba-diving certifications in tow. During a group dive, the two separate themselves from the others to dive a little deeper. An incorrect head-count suggests the entire group has returned, so the boat departs. When the pair surfaces, they make out a vessel in the distance, but it does not immediately set in that they have been left behind. With sharks lurking beneath, their survival chances grow smaller. (Thriller, Adventure, Drama, Horror) - 2003

5starmax.us.title: Mothra vs. Godzilla
5starmax.us.description: Japan comes under attack from two monsters in a giant monster battle between a rampaging Godzilla and the colossal genetically engineered moth called Mothra. (Science fiction) - 1964

5starmax.us.title: Hop
5starmax.us.description: Beneath Easter Island, in a giant factory that manufactures the world's Easter candy, the popular rabbit is preparing to pass the mantle to his son, E.B. (Russell Brand). But E.B. has no interest in the job and would rather be a drummer. He runs away to Los Angeles, where an unemployed slacker named Fred O'Hare (James Marsden) accidentally runs into him. Feigning injury, E.B. tricks Fred into giving him shelter, but an oversized chick is planning a coup back on Easter Island. (Family, Holiday, Comedy, Animated) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Ocean's 11
5starmax.us.description: Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies -- including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) -- to pull off an elaborate New Year's Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money. 5starmax.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
5starmax.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. bbcamerica.us.title: South Pacific - Ocean of Volcanoes
bbcamerica.us.description: The violent eruption of underwater volcanoes produce coral reefs that support large groups of gray reef sharks and giant manta rays; strange creatures including the vampire bug and megapode -- a bird that uses volcanic springs to incubate its eggs. (Documentary, Nature) - 2009-05-31

bbcamerica.us.title: South Pacific - Ocean of Islands
bbcamerica.us.description: A closer look into the blue will reveal a scattering of islands, from the Tropics to the sub-Antarctic waters of the Southern Ocean. (Documentary, Nature, Environment, Travel) - 2009-05-10

bbcamerica.us.title: South Pacific - Castaways
bbcamerica.us.description: The ultimate castaways, from saltwater crocodiles and giant eels to crested iguanas, overcome great odds to reach islands thousands of miles apart. (Documentary, Nature) - 2009-05-17

bbcamerica.us.title: Candyman: Farewell to the Flesh
bbcamerica.us.description: As her brother stands trial for the killing of an outspoken New Orleans professor, inner-city schoolteacher Annie Tarrant begins hearing rumors of the Candyman, a murderous, knife-handed figure of urban legend. Skeptical of the Candyman's existence, Annie follows the procedure for summoning him and suddenly finds herself celebrating the most horrifying Mardi Gras of her life. Meanwhile, Annie's mother harbors a dark family secret. (Horror, Thriller) - 1995

bbcamerica.us.title: Seed of Chucky
bbcamerica.us.description: Gentle Glen (Billy Boyd) is a ventriloquist's dummy, the offspring of evil doll Chucky (Brad Dourif) and his doll bride (Jennifer Tilly), both of whom are now deceased. When the orphaned Glen hears that a film is being made about his parents, he goes to Hollywood and resurrects them in an attempt to get to know them better. He is horrified when Chucky and his lover embark on a new killing spree, and Chucky is equally horrified that his son has no taste for evil. (Horror, Comedy, Thriller) - 2004

bbcamerica.us.title: Bride of Chucky
bbcamerica.us.description: After being cut apart by the police, killer doll Chucky (Brad Dourif) is resurrected by Tiffany (Jennifer Tilly), an ex-girlfriend of the serial murderer whose soul is inside the toy. Following an argument, Chucky kills Tiffany and transfers her soul into a bride doll. To find the magical amulet that can restore them both to human form, Chucky and Tiffany arrange to be driven to New Jersey by Jesse (Nick Stabile) and Jade (Katherine Heigl), who are unaware that their cargo is alive. (Horror, Comedy, Thriller) - 1998

bbcamerica.us.title: Thirteen Ghosts
bbcamerica.us.description: A state-of-the-art remake of the classic William Castle horror film about a family that inherits a spectacular old house from an eccentric uncle. There's just one problem: the house seems to have a dangerous agenda all its own. Trapped in their new home by strangely shifting walls, the family encounters powerful and vengeful entities that threaten to annihilate anyone in their path. (Horror, Thriller) - 2001

bbcamerica.us.title: Ghost Ship
bbcamerica.us.description: In a remote region of the Bering Sea, a boat salvage crew discovers the eerie remains of a grand passenger liner thought lost for more than 40 years. But once onboard the eerie, cavernous ship, the crew of the Arctic Warrior discovers that the decaying vessel is anything but deserted. It's home to something more deadly and horrific than anything they've encountered in all their years at sea. (Horror, Thriller) - 2002

bbcamerica.us.title: Trick 'r Treat
bbcamerica.us.description: Interwoven stories demonstrate that some traditions are best not forgotten as the residents (Anna Paquin, Brian Cox, Dylan Baker) of a small town face real ghosts and goblins on Halloween. Tales of terror reveal the consequences of extinguishing a Jack-o-Lantern before midnight and a grumpy hermit's encounter with a sinister trick-or-treater. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 2007

bbcamerica.us.title: Creepshow
bbcamerica.us.description: A compendium of five short but terrifying tales contained within a single full-length feature, this film conjures scares from traditional bogeymen and portents of doom. In one story, a monster escapes from its holding cell. Another focuses on a husband (Leslie Nielsen) with a creative way of getting back at his cheating wife. Other stories concern a rural man (Stephen King) and a visitor from outer space, and a homeowner (E.G. Marshall) with huge bug problems and a boozing corpse. (Horror, Comedy, Fantasy) - 1982

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - I.D.
bbcamerica.us.description: The detectives investigate a case involving a woman who was killed for her identity by her own sister. (Crime drama, Mystery, Thriller) - 1996-09-25

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Good Girl
bbcamerica.us.description: A young woman of Italian descent changes her story when her fingerprints turn up at the apartment of a murdered black college student. (Crime drama, Mystery, Thriller) - 1996-10-02

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Survivor
bbcamerica.us.description: In a twisting, turning whodunit, Briscoe and Curtis (Jerry Orbach, Benjamin Bratt) investigate the murder of a rare-coin dealer. With Sam Waterston, Carey Lowell, S. Epatha Merkerson and Steven Hill. (Crime drama, Mystery, Thriller) - 1996-10-23

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Corruption
bbcamerica.us.description: A crooked cop testifies against Briscoe after the detectives are involved in a botched drug-bust leading to a drug-dealer's death. (Crime drama, Mystery, Thriller) - 1996-10-30

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Double Blind
bbcamerica.us.description: A mentally ill college student participating in experimental drug research becomes a suspect in a janitor's murder. (Crime drama, Mystery, Thriller) - 1996-11-06

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Deadbeat
bbcamerica.us.description: Briscoe and Curtis investigate the murder of an underhanded used-car salesman who was wanted for unpaid child support. (Crime drama, Mystery, Thriller) - 1996-11-13

bbcamerica.us.title: Wild Patagonia - Heat and Dust
bbcamerica.us.description: Follows the path of a relentless wind from the Andes' peaks, that sweeps east through Patagonia's dry desert; the world of maras and desert-dwelling penguins; the first faltering steps of baby guanacos. (Documentary, Nature, Animals) - 2015-10-02

bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth - Mountains
bbcamerica.us.description: Touring the mightiest mountain ranges. (Science, Educational, Documentary, Nature, History) - 2006-03-12

bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth - Seasonal Forests
bbcamerica.us.description: The trees of the Taiga forest; giant sequoia, the largest living thing on the planet. (Science, Educational, Documentary, Nature, History) - 2006-12-03

bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth - From Pole to Pole
bbcamerica.us.description: Traveling around the Earth, finding where the sun always shines and where it's rarely seen; finding where water is abundant and where it's scarce. (Science, Educational, Documentary, Nature, History) - 2006-03-05

bbcamerica.us.title: Land of the Dead
bbcamerica.us.description: In a world where zombies form the majority of the population, the remaining humans build a feudal society away from the undead. Ruthless Paul Kaufman (Dennis Hopper) rules and protects this microcosm but enforces painful class distinctions. Second-in-command Cholo DeMora (John Leguizamo) attempts to lead a secret rebellion against Kaufman's tyranny, but when the zombies begin to evolve, the survivors must discover a way to protect themselves from a zombie horde that can learn and adapt. (Horror) - 2005

bbcamerica.us.title: Shaun of the Dead
bbcamerica.us.description: Shaun is a 30-something loser with a dull, easy existence. When he's not working at the electronics store, he lives with his slovenly best friend, Ed, in a small flat on the outskirts of London. The only unpredictable element in his life is his girlfriend, Liz, who wishes desperately for Shaun to grow up and be a man. When the town is inexplicably overrun with zombies, Shaun must rise to the occasion and protect both Liz and his mother. (Comedy, Horror) - 2004

bbcamerica.us.title: Army of Darkness
bbcamerica.us.description: 3rd Evil Dead movie. Ash finds himself trapped in medieval times. He must quest for the Necronomicon, a book of evil which can return him to his time. Unfortunately, he releases the evil trapped inside the book and unleashes an army of the dead. (Fantasy, Adventure, Horror, Comedy) - 1992

bbcamerica.us.title: The Return of the Living Dead
bbcamerica.us.description: When foreman Frank (James Karen) shows new employee Freddy (Thom Mathews) a secret military experiment in a supply warehouse, the two klutzes accidentally release a gas that reanimates corpses into flesh-eating zombies. As the epidemic spreads throughout Louisville, Ky., and the creatures satisfy their hunger in gory and outlandish ways, Frank and Freddy fight to survive with the help of their boss (Clu Gulager) and a mysterious mortician (Don Calfa). (Horror, Comedy) - 1985

bbcamerica.us.title: Night of the Living Dead
bbcamerica.us.description: For reasons unknown, the recently deceased are rising from the grave as flesh-hungry zombies. Fleeing from the undead horde, a small group of survivors, including Barbara (Patricia Tallman), Ben (Tony Todd) and Harry (Tom Towles), sequester themselves in a remote farmhouse. With the zombies outside the house multiplying, tensions flare, as the group argues over the best way to escape their increasingly dire situation before they are overrun completely. (Horror) - 1990

bbcamerica.us.title: Pet Sematary
bbcamerica.us.description: A family's life in small-town Maine is shattered by the evil unleashed from an ancient American Indian burial ground. - 1989

bbcamerica.us.title: Pet Sematary Two
bbcamerica.us.description: A teen (Edward Furlong) and his buddy take a shot-dead dog to a sacred burial ground where it comes back to life, riled. - 1992

bbcamerica.us.title: Criminal Minds - A Family Affair
bbcamerica.us.description: The BAU goes to Atlanta to investigate a series of murders, which they believe are being committed by more than one unsub.

bbcamerica.us.title: Criminal Minds - I Love You, Tommy Brown
bbcamerica.us.description: Multiple married couples fostering young children are murdered in Seattle; Garcia worries that Kevin is about to propose.

bbcamerica.us.title: Criminal Minds - Foundation
bbcamerica.us.description: When a young boy is found in the Arizona desert and another goes missing, the team searches for the kidnapper; Morgan draws on his difficult past to connect with the found child.

greatamericancountry.us.title: Christmas on Candy Cane Lane
greatamericancountry.us.description: Ivy Donaldson struggles with her mom's shadow, Muriel, the Christmas darling of Icicle Falls. She is now separated from her husband Rob and tries her best with her daughter.

greatamericancountry.us.title: Designing Christmas With You
greatamericancountry.us.description: With her career on the line, a decorator must work with an unexpected partner to showcase a house for an upcoming Christmas gala.

greatamericancountry.us.title: Christmas on Windmill Way
greatamericancountry.us.description: Mia Meijer expects that her Mimi will win the Christmas Market Dutch Bake-Off competition, but her Mimi has difficult news to share: she must sell the deed to their Windmill Way property, which has been in their family for generations.

greatamericancountry.us.title: Christmas at the Inn
greatamericancountry.us.description: Beth Green, a devoted café owner, returns to her hometown of Snow Ridge to help her parents host the town's most cherished tradition, the annual Yuletide Potluck, a holiday potluck that welcomes military families and veterans who might otherwise spend Christmas alone. At her parents' cozy inn, Beth meets Jack Evans, a civil engineer with the military, assigned to oversee projects at the local base over Christmas.

greatamericancountry.us.title: A Brush With Christmas
greatamericancountry.us.description: Disheartened and struggling to find time for her art, Charlotte throws out her latest painting, only to discover that it has been anonymously submitted to the Christmas art festival.

greatamericancountry.us.title: Christmas on Every Page
greatamericancountry.us.description: A woman returns home for the holidays to help her mother's struggling bookstore. As she reconnects with her roots, she starts to question whether success is measured by career milestones -- or by love, creativity, and the joy of truly belonging.

greatamericancountry.us.title: A Very Curious Christmas
greatamericancountry.us.description: A rising star reporter must uncover the identity of a local late-night bandit who has been stealing beautiful home Christmas displays across the city.

greatamericancountry.us.title: A Christmas Prayer Tradition
greatamericancountry.us.description: When a girl quietly begins a mission to answer the prayers and needs of those around her community, her family discovers that some of God's greatest works are accomplished through simple acts of kindness.

greatamericancountry.us.title: A Christmas Less Traveled
greatamericancountry.us.description: An old audio cassette of her dad's voice sends a woman on a journey to retrace her family's most memorable moments. Along the way, she meets a man who offers her a generous payment in exchange for a ride to close the most important deal of his life.

greatamericancountry.us.title: Destined at Christmas
greatamericancountry.us.description: After Kim and Theo meet in the midst of Black Friday shopping madness, they are determined to meet again.

greatamericancountry.us.title: A Paris Christmas Waltz
greatamericancountry.us.description: Emma encounters a professional dancer Leo, whose enthusiasm for competitive dancing is diminishing. However, a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity presents itself for the novice to join the pro.

greatamericancountry.us.title: Christmas in Midnight Clear
greatamericancountry.us.description: A real estate developer plans to modernize an economically struggling town from the inside out. However, when she meets the local pastor and pillar of the community, her vision faces more than legal challenges as something deeper begins to blossom.

greatamericancountry.us.title: Santa, Maybe
greatamericancountry.us.description: Theater director Lila must rise to the challenge of putting on the perfect Christmas ballet alongside a difficult new colleague, while also discovering her office secret Santa in the process.

greatamericancountry.us.title: A Little Women's Christmas
greatamericancountry.us.description: A contemporary retelling of the classic novel "Little Women," following the lives and loves of the March sisters in a small Tennessee town during Christmastime.

greatamericancountry.us.title: A Christmas Castle Proposal
greatamericancountry.us.description: Despite busy schedules causing distance, Olivia and Prince Alexander travel to Torovia for Christmas with his family. Clashing cultures between their families lead to various mishaps.

greatamericancountry.us.title: I'm Glad It's Christmas
greatamericancountry.us.description: An aspiring Broadway singer is convinced to participate in a small-scale production for the local Christmas celebration.

greatamericancountry.us.title: A Royal Christmas Tail
greatamericancountry.us.description: A prince swaps a glass slipper for a dog tag in his Christmas search for the woman and her dog who stole his heart during one enchanted holiday encounter.

greatamericancountry.us.title: Catering Christmas
greatamericancountry.us.description: Fledgling caterer Molly Frost is hired by perfectionist Jean Harrison for the renowned Harrison Foundation's annual Christmas Gala, but things get complicated when she falls for Jean's nephew, a photographer with no desire to take over the foundation. Molly shows Carson all the good his family is able to provide.

greatamericancountry.us.title: A Christmas Miracle for Daisy
greatamericancountry.us.description: Interior designer Whitney Alder agrees to work for her ex-boyfriend Cormac, who has adopted his orphaned niece, Daisy. Daisy's Christmas wish is for Whitney and Cormac to get together so she can have the mother she always wanted.

greatamericancountry.us.title: Another Sweet Christmas
greatamericancountry.us.description: When Sophie and Sam's picture-perfect love story is transformed into a Christmas movie, their hometown of Waynesbridge, Washington, becomes a dazzling holiday film set. But as the spotlight grows brighter, real-life challenges soon follow.

greatamericancountry.us.title: Christmas Under the Northern Lights
greatamericancountry.us.description: A historian seeks inspiration for her next project in her family's hometown, which is famous for experiencing the Northern Lights. While there, she bonds with a local tour guide who shows her the town's Christmas traditions.

greatamericancountry.us.title: A Kindhearted Christmas
greatamericancountry.us.description: To capture the holiday spirit, Jaime anonymously gives gifts to those in need. Word spreads and people in town wonder who this "Secret Santa" is. She remains anonymous and meets Scott. Jamie tries to keep her secret and pursue a new romance.

hallmark.us.title: The Perfect Christmas Present
hallmark.us.description: Tom Jacobs has built a business around helping clients find the perfect gift for their loved ones. When he's hired to find a gift for his friend's girlfriend, he finds himself in a bit of trouble: The more he researches her, the more he likes her. (Holiday, Movie, Romance, TV Movie) - 2017-11-04

hallmark.us.title: My Norwegian Holiday
hallmark.us.description: A grieving woman forges a deep connection with a Norwegian man when he discovers she has a troll figurine from his hometown. She soon agrees to accompany him to Norway to uncover the troll's origins and find her own path to healing, love and family. (Drama, Holiday, Movie, Romance, TV Movie) - 2023-12-01

hallmark.us.title: Christmas Made to Order
hallmark.us.description: When an architect finds himself hosting his family for Christmas, he turns to a holiday coordinator for help. Her expert Christmas spirit brings his family together, but neither expected it to bring them closer to each other. (Holiday, Movie, Romance, TV Movie) - 2018-12-23

hallmark.us.title: Take Me Back for Christmas
hallmark.us.description: A Christmas wish grants Renée the successful life she's always dreamed of -- except she finds herself no longer married to her beloved husband. (Comedy, Holiday, Movie, Romance, Romantic comedy) - 2023-07-15

hallmark.us.title: Deck the Walls

network.us.title: Chicago P.D. - Ties That Bind
network.us.description: Upton and Burgess find themselves in a difficult situation when Intelligence tracks a cache of cop killer machine guns to a local gun show in Wisconsin. (Drama)

network.us.title: Chicago P.D. - Good Men
network.us.description: When Cruz's undercover work reveals a lead in a case tracking multiple robberies, the situation escalates quickly, causing friction between Voight's Intelligence Unit and the Chicago Fire Department. (Drama)

network.us.title: Chicago P.D. - The Forgotten
network.us.description: Voight and the Intelligence Unit focus all their effort and resources into investigating the disappearance of an exotic dancer who served as a long-time criminal informant for their team. (Drama)

network.us.title: Chicago P.D. - Pain Killer
network.us.description: A mayoral candidate is shot by an unidentified sniper, and Intelligence races to catch the shooter before he can take out his next target. (Drama)

network.us.title: Chicago P.D. - This City
network.us.description: With the threat of a gang war looming, Voight and Ray Price must organize a peace summit to end the bloodshed before more innocent people get hurt; Burgess evaluates her future with Blair. (Drama)

network.us.title: Chicago P.D. - What Could Have Been
network.us.description: Intelligence's investigation into the murder of Burgess' boyfriend threatens to reveal a dark side she was unaware of; the real motivation for his murder uncovers a much more unsettling truth. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - The Punch List
network.us.description: The SVU helps a man come to terms with being victimized; Benson tries to support a victim's family when tragedy strikes twice. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Duty to Report
network.us.description: When Chief McGrath's daughter discloses a sexual assault, Benson must balance the intricacies of the investigation with McGrath's impulsive actions. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Zone Rouge
network.us.description: A cryptic message sends SVU on a new track to find Maddie; Benson tries to help a federal agent when the case hits too close to home; Capt. Curry tries to make amends with Fin. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Truth Embargo
network.us.description: As Benson teams up with the FBI on an unsolved case, Fin and Velasco investigate a flash mob robbery that led to a sexual assault. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - The Grid Plan
network.us.description: A Midwestern tourist is viciously attacked in Times Square; as the squad scours the area for clues, the victim takes the investigation into her own hands; a secret motive threatens to derail Carisi's case. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Undertow
network.us.description: A complicated case of sex and drug use divides the squad; Carisi must convince a jury to focus on the law and not the defendant's accusations. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Let Me Bring Pardon
network.us.description: The doctor of a comatose woman calls SVU when he discovers his patient is pregnant; Benson must convince the family to reject magical thinking and look at the facts. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Accomplice Liability
network.us.description: Carisi attempts to put aside his role as prosecutor to serve as a witness in a trial; Benson tries to help a rape survivor struggling with her recovery. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Clickbait
network.us.description: When a tween suffers a life-threatening miscarriage, the SVU must unravel a web of online fabrications to identify a suspect; Rollins carefully weighs her career options. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Feed the Craving
network.us.description: When a woman in active labor is abducted, Rollins and Curry look to her doula for an account of events; Carisi tries to get a confession in front of the jury. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - False Idols
network.us.description: The SVU must determine fact from fantasy when a famous author twists the details of a serious crime; Fin has a challenging day at work. (Drama)

network.us.title: The Rainmaker - Cards Up
network.us.description: Rudy takes Victor's case to court while Bruiser and Sarah face troubles of their own. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Tangled
network.us.description: An estranged son and a former patient are the prime suspects in the murder of a prominent doctor and the rape of his wife. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Redemption
network.us.description: Stabler pairs with a bitter cop (David Keith) to track a serial rapist/murderer who was recently released from prison. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Sacrifice
network.us.description: Benson and Stabler enter the world of pornography when they investigate the shooting and rape of an Arkansas man. (Drama)

network.us.title: Dateline - The Devil in Disguise
network.us.description: An ex-Navy man marries the love of his life; five months later, his new bride finds him dead on their bedroom floor, leaving family and authorities puzzled. (News Magazine, Documentary)

network.us.title: Dateline - The Halloween Party
network.us.description: A community comes together to search for a young woman who goes missing from a Halloween party. (News Magazine, Documentary)

network.us.title: Dateline - The Halloween Party
network.us.description: A community comes together to search for a young woman who goes missing from a Halloween party. (News Magazine, Documentary)

network.us.title: Chicago P.D. - Doubt
network.us.description: When Kelton is found murdered, Voight's grudge against the mayor-elect puts him under suspicion; Upton and Halstead are eager to prove their sergeant's innocence, but the more evidence they gather, the closer they come to doing the opposite. (Drama)

network.us.title: Chicago P.D. - Assets
network.us.description: When Atwater goes undercover in a drug syndicate, he learns there may be more to its kingpin than meets the eye; Halstead tries to join Atwater undercover, but finds himself at a disadvantage; Voight petitions the brass to show Ruzek leniency. (Drama)

network.us.title: Chicago P.D. - Familia
network.us.description: After a botched carjacking turns out to be something much bigger, Voight's unit goes toe-to-toe with a smart drug kingpin who only works with women; new recruit Vanessa Rojas struggles with the transition from undercover to intelligence. (Drama)

network.us.title: Chicago P.D. - Infection, Part III
network.us.description: After zeroing in on a suspect responsible for bioterrorism, the P.D. prepares to undertake its biggest manhunt yet; Upton is torn between helping track down the perp and providing emotional support to a scared young girl who needs her. (Drama)

network.us.title: Chicago P.D. - Brother's Keeper
network.us.description: A murder in a Bulgarian neighborhood results in a challenging investigation when locals won't talk to police; Ruzek has a clash with a patrol officer. (Drama)

network.us.title: Chicago P.D. - False Positive
network.us.description: The shocking murder of young boys affects Halstead; Crawford encourages Intelligence to use a new facial recognition software to help identify a suspect, but the plan backfires. (Drama)

network.us.title: Chicago P.D. - Informant
network.us.description: Voight pulls Darius in after Crawford asks intelligence to investigate a dangerous drug, but there is little trust in the relationship; when a plan to nail a dealer goes awry, the team must make a tough decision about Darius. (Drama)

network.us.title: Chicago P.D. - No Regrets
network.us.description: After injuring herself while pursuing a suspect, Burgess receives a shocking diagnosis; a homicide case turns into a missing persons case, with a sinister twist; Voight has to decide between justice and the letter of the law. (Drama)

network.us.title: Chicago P.D. - Absolution
network.us.description: Halstead's secret ongoing relationship with a woman connected to another case puts him in jeopardy. (Drama)

network.us.title: Chicago P.D. - Mercy
network.us.description: As it awaits news of Halstead's fate, the team turns its attention to an illegal arms dealer; Atwater discovers his brother is in Chicago and could be tied to the case; Voight must deal with Halstead's shooter; Burgess makes her decision. (Drama)

network.us.title: 9-1-1 - Performance Anxiety
network.us.description: The 118 race to emergencies at a commercial bakery and a bodybuilding competition; Bobby's annual performance reviews send Chimney to the firefighter academy, where he runs into a familiar face; Eddie's aunt gets involved in his personal life. (Drama)

network.us.title: 9-1-1 - Death and Taxes
network.us.description: A fire breaks out in an accountant's office and a car crashes into a "living funeral"; Athena is shocked when a suspect dies in her custody minutes after she arrests him; Buck is attracted to a death doula; Maddie and Chimney are audited by the IRS. (Drama)

network.us.title: 9-1-1 - Lost & Found
network.us.description: The 118 race to rescue two roommates desperately trying to find a needle in a haystack at a landfill, and help a woman whose nightmare dream suddenly becomes a painful reality; Athena and Maddie team up to find a missing boy in a crowded mall. (Drama)

network.us.title: 9-1-1 - Love Is in the Air
network.us.description: A wedding proposal tragically intersects with a bank robbery; a bride is literally stuck on her way to the altar; Athena talks a victim through her grief; Buck finds a surprise visitor on his doorstep. (Drama)

network.us.title: 9-1-1 - Eat the Rich
network.us.description: In honor of Bobby Nash's sacrifice, the 118 comes together to dedicate the firehouse in his memory; when a billionaire tech giant is involved in a life-or-death emergency, the team must race to his aid. (Drama)

network.us.title: 9-1-1 - Spiraling
network.us.description: As a geostorm ravages Earth, Athena and Hen's space mission teeters on the edge; on the ground, the 118 battles chaos when technology goes rogue. (Drama)

network.us.title: 9-1-1 - The Sky Is Falling
network.us.description: Athena and Hen face increasing dangers in space as friends both near and far try to get them home safely; the 118 continues to help victims of the geostorm and falling debris. (Drama)

network.us.title: 9-1-1 - Jinx
network.us.description: The 118 has a day from hell with a never-ending series of bizarre emergency calls; a man tapes himself to a freeway billboard; a restaurant manager destroys his own business; Eddie feels a spark with Christopher's former teacher. (Drama)

network.us.title: 9-1-1 - There Goes the Neighborhood
network.us.description: A man gets pinned under a Humvee; a garage band rocks out too hard; Michael notices strange behavior at a nearby apartment; Hen's mother unexpectedly arrives and announces she is moving to Los Angeles. (Drama)

network.us.title: 9-1-1 - Breaking Point
network.us.description: The 118 are called to the tarmac when a flight attendant reaches her limit with her flight's passengers; Eddie worries Christopher will not accept him dating; Buck reconnects with an old flame. (Drama)

network.us.title: 9-1-1 - Blindsided
network.us.description: Athena and the 118 race to save lives after a drunken driver causes a deadly pileup on the freeway; Maddie goes into labor; Hen and Karen are devastated as they prepare their foster daughter to be reunited with her birth mother. (Drama)

retroplex.us.title: Back to the Secret Garden
retroplex.us.description: Camilla Belle stars as Lizzie Buscana, a spirited orphan girl, in this sequel to the beloved adaptation of Frances Hodgson Burnett's novel. Lady Mary Craven, the original heroine, now an adult, befriends Lizzie and invites her to move from Brooklyn to Misselthwaite Manor, which is now an orphanage. After hearing about the secret garden, Lizzie is disappointed upon arriving to find it in a state of decay, and she endeavors to restore the garden to its past splendor. (Children, Fantasy, Drama) - 2000

retroplex.us.title: The Woman in Green
retroplex.us.description: When a number of attractive women are found dead and with fingers missing, Sherlock Holmes (Basil Rathbone) and Dr. Watson (Nigel Bruce) investigate. Though evidence points to a psychotic killer, Holmes begins to believe that there's more to the case than initially meets the eye, a notion that leads him to uncover the involvement of his archenemy, Professor Moriarty (Henry Daniell). Who is working with Moriarty on such a dastardly plot, and what are their motives? (Mystery) - 1945

retroplex.us.title: Dressed to Kill
retroplex.us.description: Holmes and Watson hunt for three music boxes containing directions to the whereabouts of six valuable engraving plates stolen from the Bank of England. They find themselves in competition with professional thieves also out to find the clues, which were hidden by a spiteful jailbird before the music boxes went up for auction. (Mystery) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Sherlock Holmes and the Secret Weapon
retroplex.us.description: Sherlock Holmes (Basil Rathbone) saves noted Swiss physicist Franz Tobel (William Post Jr.) from the Gestapo in Zurich and smuggles him to London. There, Tobel is reunited with his wife, Charlotte (Kaaren Verne), to whom he gives a coded message in the event he disappears. Tobel presents the weapon he developed to government officials, and when he is subsequently abducted by arch-villain Professor Moriarty (Lionel Atwill), Holmes and Dr. Watson (Nigel Bruce) risk their lives to find him. (Mystery) - 1942

retroplex.us.title: Down Missouri Way
retroplex.us.description: In this musical, agriculture professor Jane Colwell (Martha O'Driscoll) is seeking a quiet getaway when she takes her prized mule off to visit an Ozarks farming community. But upon arrival she is stunned to discover a film crew diligently at work on a new movie. Soon, Jane and her mule companion are swept up in the filmmaking frenzy. While the photogenic mule upstages the production's human star (Renee Godfrey), Jane finds herself falling for the feature's dashing producer (William Wright). (Musical comedy) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Under California Stars
retroplex.us.description: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: Colorado Serenade
retroplex.us.description: One night, while out riding his horse, Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) comes upon a stagecoach being robbed by bandits. He intervenes and rescues the passengers, including a newly appointed judge, Roy Hilton (Forrest Taylor), who's traveling to the nearby town of Rawhide to bring law and order to the community. After witnessing Dean's heroics, the judge enlists the cowboy to help him, but their efforts are complicated by the arrival of mysterious drifter Nevada (David Sharpe). (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Dressed to Kill

retroplex.us.title: The Woman in Green
retroplex.us.description: When a number of attractive women are found dead and with fingers missing, Sherlock Holmes (Basil Rathbone) and Dr. Watson (Nigel Bruce) investigate. Though evidence points to a psychotic killer, Holmes begins to believe that there's more to the case than initially meets the eye, a notion that leads him to uncover the involvement of his archenemy, Professor Moriarty (Henry Daniell). Who is working with Moriarty on such a dastardly plot, and what are their motives? (Mystery) - 1945

retroplex.us.title: Sherlock Holmes and the Secret Weapon
retroplex.us.description: Sherlock Holmes (Basil Rathbone) saves noted Swiss physicist Franz Tobel (William Post Jr.) from the Gestapo in Zurich and smuggles him to London. There, Tobel is reunited with his wife, Charlotte (Kaaren Verne), to whom he gives a coded message in the event he disappears. Tobel presents the weapon he developed to government officials, and when he is subsequently abducted by arch-villain Professor Moriarty (Lionel Atwill), Holmes and Dr. Watson (Nigel Bruce) risk their lives to find him. (Mystery) - 1942

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Hand-Crafted Pasta in Puglia

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Masterclass In Sicilian Sweets

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Fast Paced Roman Recipes

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Italian Alps Comfort Food
tastemade.us.description: Jamie is high up in the Italian Alps cooking some great comfort food, including dumplings, mind-blowing macaroni cheese, and a classic red wine and sausage risotto. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Tuscan Farmhouse Classics

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders - Speedy Chicken and Mushroom Puff Pastry Pie

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders - An Eggplant Burger, Seared Salmon, & Squash Casserole!
tastemade.us.description: Jamie shares three easy one-pan wonders: an aubergine burger, sesame salmon, and chickpea & squash casserole! (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders - Not Your Nonna's Gnocchi and Meatballs
tastemade.us.description: In this episode Jamie takes midweek meals up a notch, knocking out a flavour-packed, simple gnocchi supper and giant spicy meatballs full of delicious time-saving cheats, and turns a family favourite on its head with his upside-down fish pie. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders - Jamie's Outrageously Good Pulled Pork

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders - Salmon Pasta, a Loaded Burger, and Sticky Toffee Apple Buns!

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out - The Only Pulled Pork Recipe You'll Ever Need

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - The King of Open-Fire Paella

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Holy Mackerel!

cinevault.us.title: I Dreamed of Africa
cinevault.us.description: Inspired by the true story of indomitable Kuki Gallmann, the film tells of a beautiful and inquisitive woman who had the courage to escape from her comfortable yet monotonous life in Italy to start anew in the African wilderness with her son, Emanuele, and her new husband, Paolo. Gallmann faces great danger there but eventually becomes a celebrated conservationist. (Drama, Movie) - 2000-05-05

cinevault.us.title: Nothing in Common
cinevault.us.description: A successful advertising executive, David Basner, is working on a project that could make him partner at his company. When his parents suddenly end their 36-year marriage, he is thrown into the role of caregiver, dealing with his delicate mother, Lorraine, and his combative father, Max, who provides constant aggravation and bitter remarks. When one of his parents gets sick, David must choose what is more important, his family or his career. (Comedy drama, Movie) - 1986-11-08

cinevault.us.title: Blue-Eyed Butcher
cinevault.us.description: Susan Wright (Sara Paxton) stands trial for the murder of her husband (Justin Bruening) in their Texas home. (Docudrama, Movie) - 2012-03-03

cinevault.us.title: Red Water
cinevault.us.description: Former oil rig worker John Sanders (Lou Diamond Phillips) became a Louisiana fishing captain after a tragic accident ended his career. In need of money, he agrees to help his ex-wife, Kelli (Kristy Swanson), whose company is having trouble extracting oil upriver. Meanwhile, thugs working for a Jamaican gangster head to the same bayou searching for $3 million buried underwater. Both the scientists and the criminals are menaced by a man-eating shark that can survive in fresh water. (Movie, Thriller) - 2003-08-17

cinevault.us.title: The Fog
cinevault.us.description: The prosperous town of Antonio Bay, Ore., is born in blood, as the town's founders get their money by murdering a colony of lepers. But the truth of what they did is concealed from subsequent generations. More than 100 years later, Elizabeth Williams (Maggie Grace), whose family lives in Antonio Bay, returns just as a statue in tribute to the founders is to be unveiled. When a mysterious fog rolls in, Elizabeth and her boyfriend (Tom Welling) soon discover it has vengeful supernatural powers. (Horror, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 2005-10-14

cinevault.us.title: Darkness Falls
cinevault.us.description: In Maine, the residents of Darkness Falls are all aware of the legend of Matilda Dixon, an old woman who was tragically murdered by a mob in the 1800s because the townspeople thought she was killing children. Now Darkness Falls has to contend with Matilda's supernatural wrath. Childhood friends Kyle (Chaney Kley) and Caitlin (Emma Caulfield) return home to uncover the truth behind the legend after Caitlin's little brother (Lee Cormie) has recurring nightmares about Matilda. (Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2003-01-24

cinevault.us.title: Lake Placid vs. Anaconda
cinevault.us.description: A giant crocodile goes head-to-head with a giant anaconda. The town sheriff must find a way to destroy the two monsters before they kill the whole town. (Action, Comedy, Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2015-04-25

cinevault.us.title: The Exorcism of Emily Rose
cinevault.us.description: The Rev. Moore is prosecuted for the wrongful death of a girl thought to be demonically possessed, because he administered the church-sanctioned exorcism that ultimately killed her. Prosecuting attorney Ethan Thomas contends that the young woman, Emily, suffered from schizophrenia and should have been medically diagnosed. Meanwhile, defense lawyer Erin Bruner argues that Emily's condition cannot be explained by science alone. (Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2005-09-09

cinevault.us.title: Lakeview Terrace
cinevault.us.description: An uptight cop (Samuel L. Jackson), the self-appointed watchdog of his neighborhood, strongly disapproves of the interracial newlyweds (Patrick Wilson, Kerry Washington) who just moved in next door. He becomes increasingly hostile toward the innocent pair, going to great lengths to force them out of their home. The situation changes when the young couple decide to fight back. (Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2008-09-19

cinevault.us.title: The Art of War
cinevault.us.description: He is both agent and weapon - a critical line of defense for the Secretary General of the United Nations. He does not even officially exist. Neil Shaw, an American agent who must uncover an international plot to bring down the United Nations on the eve of an historic summit with China. A mysterious chain of events leads to the murder of the Chinese U.N. Ambassador. When Shaw is accused of the crime, he must go underground -- in effect, vanish from his own life. (Action, Movie, Thriller) - 2000-08-23

bravovault.us.description: S04 E05 Cock of the Walk Convinced Kristen is cheating on him, James hooks up with Lala; Lisa teaches her staff about fine wine; Jax schemes to attract Lala away from James and recruits Kristen to help him.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S04 E06 Love Bites Lisa throws two huge parties for Gay Pride; James flaunts fresh love bites, and everyone wants to know who was responsible; Tom Sandoval and Tom Schwartz kick-start Shay's makeover; Jax seizes an opportunity to move in on Lala.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S04 E07 Spit Take Lisa invites a group of underprivileged children to SUR, which includes a serving of bad behavior on the part of her staff; Jax stands up for Kristen after her breakup turns ugly; Tom Schwartz and Tom Sandoval's business plan fails to impress.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S04 E08 Dirty Thirty Lisa advises the women to get back at their boyfriends for going to Las Vegas, so Lala, Katie and Ariana get cozy at Scheana's slumber party; Jax, Schwartz and Sandoval strive to remain loyal to their girlfriends while in Sin City.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S04 E09 What Happened in Vegas Tom Sandoval and Tom Schwartz divulge shocking news about their trip to Las Vegas; Kristen returns to SUR, but Ariana is not ready to forgive; Tom Sandoval and Ariana take the stage at the Improv; James tries to sabotage Jax's love life.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S04 E10 No Strings Attached Tom Schwartz plans on going down on one knee to propose to Katie, but Lisa frets that his complicated scheme will end in disaster; Brittany moves in with Jax; Kristen and James get left out in the cold when the SUR crew plans a tropical vacation.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S04 E11 Fully Engaged Lisa Vanderpump holds Stassi at arm's length; Scheana and Ariana realize their friendship is damaged; James schemes to get an invitation to Hawaii with the others; Katie shows off her engagement ring at SUR; Faith and Lala go skinny-dipping.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S04 E12 Leis, Liquor and Lies The gang heads to Hawaii to celebrate Jax and Tom's birthdays; Tom learns Scheana sent derogatory text messages about him to Ariana's mother; Katie lashes out when Lala swims naked in front of Schwartz.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S04 E13 The Bitch Is Back When Stassi visits Kristen, she reveals the truth about her sex tape; Ariana refuses to accept Scheana's apologies; Lala kicks James out of bed; Jax winds up in jail.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S04 E14 Sex, Lies and Stassi's Videotape Accused of shoplifting, Jax must answer to the law, to his girlfriend and to Lisa Vanderpump; Stassi returns to SUR to repay Lisa for keeping the sex tape from leaking; James and Lala cannot keep their hands off each other during a photo shoot.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S04 E15 Pucker & Pout Katie launches her Website with a party, but a surprise appearance by James and a text message from Stassi threaten to ruin the event; Jax adjusts to life as an unemployed outlaw while Brittany adjusts to her new life as sole breadwinner.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S04 E16 Bitch Ghost When Stassi runs into her former crew members at Lala's house party, Scheana must finally answer for her part in Stassi's sex tape scandal; Jax brags about his girlfriend's breast enhancement; Tom Schwartz lands in hot water after he quits his job.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S04 E17 Beach, Please Jax's girlfriend, Brittany, undergoes breast augmentation surgery; Lisa is faced with a big decision after James makes a scene at PUMP; Tom Sandoval removes the tattoo on his buttocks; Ariana makes a stunning statement at Katie's beach party.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S04 E18 Too Little, Too Late Against Lisa's advice, Katie surprises Stassi in Palm Springs, Calif.; James convinces himself that Kristen is the answer to his problems; Scheana worries about losing her friends; Jax, Tom Schwartz and Peter try their hands at babysitting.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S04 E19 Just the T.I.P. Katie begs to hold her engagement party at Villa Rosa, but Lisa Vanderpump balks because Stassi and Kristen are on the guest list; Jax questions everything as his court date gets closer; Tom Sandoval shoots a video to launch his music career.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S04 E20 Push Comes to Shove Lisa Vanderpump hosts Katie and Tom's engagement party; Stassi and Kristen stir up trouble; Jax must atone for his sins during a reunion with Stassi; Tom Sandoval performs his new song at SUR; Lala gets close to Kristen and James.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S05 E01 Summer Bodies Jax spreads a shocking rumor about his girlfriend, Brittany, and Kristen; Stassi rallies the women against James and Lala for fat shaming bride-to-be Katie; the group uncovers a scandalous piece of gossip about Lala's love life.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S05 E02 What Went Down Lisa organizes a dog charity event; Brittany threatens to leave Jax for spreading rumors about her sexual encounter with Kristen; James apologizes for the horrible things he said to Scheana and Katie; Tom Schwartz asks for a prenuptial agreement.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S05 E03 Call It Like I See It Stassi, Scheana and Kristen are all asked to be a part of Katie's bridal party, but Ariana is left out in the cold as a result of her friendship with Lala; Schwartz serves up a spicy revenge to Jax and Sandoval; Katie questions Scheana's loyalty.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S05 E04 Thirsty Girls Scheana shuts down Lala's overtures of friendship in an effort to please Katie; James is flying high when his pageant queen girlfriend comes to town for the summer; Katie lashes out at Schwartz after learning he's secretly seeking therapy.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S05 E05 Cold Feet While scouting out a wedding venue, Schwartz shows signs of cold feet, and Katie hits him below the belt; Tom takes Ariana on a date but discovers that he wants marriage and children more than she does; Scheana learns a rumor about Lala.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S05 E06 Pride In the wake of the attack on the gay nightclub in Orlando, Fla., Lisa puts her own safety aside to ride in the Pride Parade; jealousy sparks the nastiest fight of Tom and Ariana's relationship; Stassi plans a birthday trip to Montauk, N.Y.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S05 E07 The Sociopath Test Scheana and Kristen throw a surprise party for Shay and Carter, but Scheana gets surprised when Stassi and Katie attack her for sympathizing with Lala; later, Jax reveals himself to be a certifiable sociopath on Stassi's podcast.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S05 E08 No Show After a vicious fight with Stassi and Katie, Scheana must decide whether she'll still go with them on Stassi's birthday trip to Montauk, N.Y.; Lala begins to dread Ariana's birthday trip when she learns she'll be stuck in close quarters with Jax.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S05 E09 The Talk of Montauk Sandoval, Schwartz and Jax vow not to let Lala's no-show ruin Ariana's NASCAR birthday weekend; Stassi's birthday trip gets off to a rocky start; Lisa learns troubling news about Lala's situation; Scheana feels like an outsider.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Sicily and Puglia Rick travels from Sicily to Puglia.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Corfu Rick departs Italy and makes his way to the Greek island of Corfu, where he attends a family feast; he visits kitchens in restaurants all over the island and learns how to make dishes such as a Greek peasant salad with feta and olives and more.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Mallorca and Catalonia In Mallorca, Rick finds wonderful seafood dishes and the most succulent roast lamb he's ever tasted, while in Barcelona he samples Catalonian food at the famous Boqueria market.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Morocco and Turkey Rick samples the delights of couscous, tagines and mint tea in Moroccan bazaars, before heading along the old silk route to south-eastern Turkey, where he tastes the finest kebabs.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Bordeaux Heading to autumnal Bordeaux; Rick arrives just in time to judge a local wine contest; he hires a 2CV for an excursion to the coast that is abundant with mussels and oysters.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Reykjavik Rick Stein heads north towards the Arctic Circle to explore the food of Reykjavík; a perfect winter break is enriched with roast lamb, rye bread baked in volcanic sand, langoustine soup and cod.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Berlin Rick enjoys a long weekend in Berlin, where history and the Avant-garde dwell side by side; a city that once made history with its divisive wall teems today with an array of innovative chefs offering seasonal creations like puréed sunflower seeds.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Vienna Rick Stein visits Vienna, the city that once ran the Austro-Hungarian Empire and continues to be home to dishes like tafelspitz and goulash; Vienna gave its name to one of Europe's most popular dishes, the wiener schnitzel.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Dieppe Rick Stein embarks on a new journey through the byways of France, from the Channel to the Mediterranean, always on the lookout for things where the British could learn from the French to enhance lives.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Alsace and Jura Rick Stein goes through France's eastern border regions of Alsace and Jura home to his favorite French dish, choucroute garni and favorite French cheese, comté.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Burgundy Rick Stein continues exploring Burgundy and practices a little entente cordiale with a château owner who cooks him sorrel soup straight out of the garden.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Perigord Rick Stein arrives in the region of Perigord, famous for decadent dishes; he discovers his favorite market in the city of Perigueux and learns about the region's historical relationship with England as the former kingdom of Aquitaine.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Roussillon Rick Stein's journey of discovery brings him to the sunnier climes of the Mediterranean, where he explores the French-Catalan legacy of Roussillon on the foothills of the Pyrenees next to the Spanish border.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Languedoc Rick Stein approaches the end of his meander through France with a final glance at the culinary delights of the Languedoc before crossing over to Provence and the Mediterranean coastline that reveals new insights into southern French cuisine.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Chocolate Chef Raymond Blanc creates four mouth-watering chocolate recipes: a simple mousse, rich chocolate delice, fondant with a melting middle, and his signature dessert: café crème, which is a chocolate-sculpted cup filled with a mousse and coffee sabayon.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Fish Raymond dives into the world of fish with the underused and affordable mackerel; he creates a light meal of grilled mackerel with a soy lime dressing.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Apples Chef Raymond Blanc looks to the UK's favorite fruit, apples, for inspiration; he returns to memories of childhood with a simple tart made with a foolproof pastry and custard filling.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Winter Vegetables Chef Blanc celebrates the season with a winter vegetable salad featuring beetroots, a celeriac purée served with a crisp-skinned roast wild duck with blackberry sauce and watercress soup.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Game and Mushrooms Chef Blanc uses two seasonal ingredients, game and mushrooms, to create a French version of a pasty called pithivier, which is filled with a rich mix of pheasant, chestnuts and dried fruits; he also makes a cep mushroom tortellini with fresh pasta.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Bread The miracle of yeast helps Raymond to create a French classic: brioche; he gets down to basics with a French country bread recipe that's essential for any baker to add to their repertoire; lastly, he makes a spectacular apple croustade.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Eggs and Cheese Chef Raymond Blanc combines the universally popular ingredients of egg and cheese to make a classic omelette with a secret technique; he then uses a Comte from his home region in France to make a family-style souffle.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 Tomatoes Chef Blanc focuses on tomatoes, opening with a simple salad recipe inspired by his mother; he also makes a creamy risotto, stuffed tomatoes glazed with cheese and a series of ices and sorbets to cleanse the palate with elegance.

filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Though only in his 20s, professional boxer Johnny Walker is on the downswing of his career and suffering from a mild form of brain damage. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire. (Thriller) - 2006

As the sheer scope, hypnotic pull and spirit-crushing mirages of the desert affect the men, their will to live and sense of identity is challenged and transformed. (Drama) - 2002

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: The Killer Clown: Murder on the Doorstep
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E02 Michael's affair leads detectives to investigate his alleged mistress Sheila; a lead on the costume from a store puts Sheila firmly in the frame, but without evidence the case goes cold; then in 2017, new DNA evidence leads detectives to an arrest.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: The Killer Clown: Murder on the Doorstep
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E03 After Sheila's arrest, the prosecution prepares for trial and the stakes are high; the prosecution's case centers on new DNA and fiber evidence; Sheila's defense attorney attempts to get the evidence thrown out.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: The Furry Detectives: Unmasking A Monster
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E01 Welcome to the Jungle When Patch O'Furr is tagged in a mysterious online post, he must face the fact that animal abusers are hiding in plain sight in the Furry Fandom; Furry Detectives comb through evidence and discover one popular YouTuber is a suspect.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: The Furry Detectives: Unmasking A Monster
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E02 Predator Becomes Prey An online 3D printing group leads to a break in the case and The Furry Detectives get their first arrest; the Zoosadist ringleader, known as SnakeThing, is still out there.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: The Furry Detectives: Unmasking A Monster
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E03 Top of the Food Chain It wasn't just animals, he was hurting people too; the self-proclaimed Furvengers must battle through legal obstacles and personal attacks as they hunt for SnakeThing.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: The Furry Detectives: Unmasking A Monster
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E04 The Animal Within A video shared in the Furry community by a person named "Monster" causes a new level of vigilante detective work; clues lead to a remote shipping container in the outback of Australia owned by a well-respected celebrity.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: The Wind
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: When a frontierswoman in the 19th-century wilderness begins to sense a sinister presence, her dread is dismissed by her husband. But a newlywed couple arrives, amplifying fears and setting a shocking chain of events into motion.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Eli Roth's History of Horror
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E01 Zombies Zombies are the monsters of the 21st century, and America's major contribution to horror; a look at what set off zombie fever leads to George Romero, who made zombies a metaphor for social ills.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Eli Roth's History of Horror
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E02 Slashers, Part 1 Slasher films make a killing in the '80s, but their violence, perceived misogyny and endless sequels almost end the genre; supernatural killers Chucky and Freddy save them from extinction.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Eli Roth's History of Horror
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E03 Slashers, Part 2 The evolution of slashers, from Freddy Krueger to Candyman to the terrifying Hannibal Lecter in the '90s, to torture porn in the 2000s as a response to post-9/11 panic.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Eli Roth's History of Horror
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E04 The Demons Inside The fear that demons will enter one's body and make one do terrible things inspires some of the most frightening films ever made, including the masterpieces "Rosemary's Baby" and "The Exorcist."

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Eli Roth's History of Horror
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E05 Killer Creatures Monsters hold a special place in the history of horror as the killer predators in nature; the nightmare creatures of the fantastic are waiting to escape.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Eli Roth's History of Horror
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E06 Vampires Modern vampires come in many guises, but they all address a fascination with sex and death; from the ghastly Count Orlok to the glam vampires of "True Blood," thirsty fiends are endlessly appealing.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Eli Roth's History of Horror
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E07 Ghost Stories Ghost movies have been with movie viewers since the dawn of cinema; some ghosts are benevolent, some ghosts are malicious, but they all represent the mystery of what happens to people after death.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: The Vigil
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: Terror strikes when an Orthodox Jewish man agrees to watch over the dead body of a community member in a dilapidated Brooklyn home.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Exam
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: Eight candidates cooperate in order to secure a job with a prestigious company.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Eli Roth's History of Horror
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S02 E03 Body Horror Sometimes disgusting, body horror films make audience members question their prejudices against physical difference, their attitudes about sex and gender, their fear of disease and contamination, and how much appearance determines destiny.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: True Crime Story: Look Into My Eyes
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E01 Absorb Attention At North Port High School in Florida, three students die within months of each other; as the community learns more, they discover a common thread: all three students were hypnotized by their principal, Dr. George Kenney, not long before they died.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: True Crime Story: Look Into My Eyes
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E02 Bypass the Critical Dr. George Kenney begins to reveal his side of the story; as details emerge about the deaths and Marcus, Wesley and Brittany's parents speak out, an investigation into Kenney's hypnosis practice begins; the North Port community grows suspicious.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: True Crime Story: Look Into My Eyes
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E03 Activate the Unconscious The press catches wind of the story, and it captures headlines worldwide; Dr. Kenney is asked to leave North Port High, and as the criminal trial heats up, the community is split on his culpability; a student comes forward with a new perspective.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: True Crime Story: Look Into My Eyes
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E04 The Outcome Pressure mounts against the school board to take accountability; Dr. Kenney leaves North Port for what seems like the final time; the community grapples with guilt and grief; Stephen offers an intimate look into Kenney's hypnosis practice.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: True Crime Story: It Couldn't Happen Here
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E01 Adel, Georgia The town of Adel, Ga., is rocked by a brutal robbery homicide, and locals quickly point to an outsider as the killer; over 20 years later, new evidence raises the startling question if an innocent man is serving life for another man's crime.

historychannel.us.title: The UnXplained - Alien Close Encounters

(Paranormal, Documentary) - 2026-08-07

historychannel.us.title: The UnXplained - Mighty Kingdoms Unearthed
historychannel.us.description: Throughout civilization there are many kingdoms and mighty empires that have risen, only to one day fall. And for some of them-like the Inca that built Machu Picchu-their eventual demise remains a mystery. What can we discover from clues left behind by these once great empires? Could the Vikings, using their longships and traits as skilled navigators, have travelled farther into America than what we are led to believe? (Paranormal, Documentary) - 2026-02-27

historychannel.us.description: Twisting rivers, large lakes and massive oceans cover most of the planet; for centuries, people have wondered about activity deep beneath the surface; as technology advances, humanity pushes farther into deep ocean waters, mapping and uncovering new species and biomes; this interest in global waters raises new inquiries regarding cursed man-made lakes and isolated future discoveries beneath Antarctic ice. (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2026-10-20

historychannel.us.title: The UnXplained Special Presentation - Shadow Societies ᴺᵉʷ
historychannel.us.description: We've all wondered about mysterious societies that operate in the shadows, holding the potential to shape our daily lives. It is an unnerving thought that unaccountable, unseen forces are actively steering our lives, potentially for the worse. (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2026-10-27

historychannel.us.title: The UnXplained Special Presentation - Lost Fortunes ᴺᵉʷ

historychannel.us.title: The UnXplained Special Presentation - Powerful Objects

paranormalfiles.us.title: Unsealed: America's Conspiracy Files
paranormalfiles.us.description: Some people think everything is a conspiracy. Luckily for them, the FBI declassified decades' worth of government documents in April 2011, allowing people to gain more insight behind some of the most popular conspiracy theories. Each episode of this series investigates a compelling theory by opening these and other files. After acquiring new information, the show's team of specialists re-examines faulty assumptions, looks for inconsistencies and explores new leads in an attempt to get to the bottom of each case. Just make sure you have your tin foil handy when watching the show. (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

paranormalfiles.us.title: The Conspiracy Show
paranormalfiles.us.description: Many believe that there are things in this world that aren't made public that the average person isn't supposed to know about. The truth may be hidden, but there are some people, like host Richard Syrett, who investigate these conspiracies and try to uncover the secrets. "The Conspiracy Show" examines claims of supernatural creatures, political cover-ups, medical discoveries, extraterrestrial life, paranormal phenomena and other unexplained mysteries. paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone." (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17
