shadesofblack.us.title: Eve's Bayou
shadesofblack.us.description: Over the course of a long, hot Louisiana summer, a 10-year-old black girl, Eve Batiste (Jurnee Smollett), discovers that her family's affluent existence is merely a facade. The philandering of her suave doctor father, Louis (Samuel L. Jackson), creates a rift, throwing Eve's mother, Roz (Lynn Whitfield), and teenage sister, Cicely (Meagan Good), into emotional turmoil. Eve, though, manages to find some solace with her quirky psychic aunt, Mozelle (Debbi Morgan). (Drama) - 1997

shadesofblack.us.title: Final Shot: The Hank Gathers Story
shadesofblack.us.description: Inspired by his mother (Nell Carter) and a priest (George Kennedy) in Philadelphia, he (Victor Love) rises to basketball All-American at Loyola Marymount. (Biography) - 1992

shadesofblack.us.title: Fled
shadesofblack.us.description: During a routine prison work detail, convict Piper (Laurence Fishburne) is chained to Dodge (Stephen Baldwin), a cyberhacker, when gunfire breaks out. Apparently, the attack is related to stolen money that the Mafia is after, and some computer files that somebody wants desperately to bury. The pair, who don't exactly enjoy each other's company, escape and must work together if they are to reach Atlanta alive. Luckily, they meet a woman (Salma Hayek) who may be willing to help them. (Action) - 1996

shadesofblack.us.title: Akeelah and the Bee
shadesofblack.us.description: Akeelah, an 11-year-old girl living in South Los Angeles, discovers she has a talent for spelling, which she hopes will take her to the National Spelling Bee. (Children, Drama) - 2006

shadesofblack.us.title: Beyond the Lights
shadesofblack.us.description: Though she's been groomed for stardom all her life by an overbearing mother (Minnie Driver), singer Noni (Gugu Mbatha-Raw) is having trouble dealing with her success. Feeling unable to cope any longer, Noni tries to kill herself, but luckily Kaz (Nate Parker), the police officer assigned to be her bodyguard, thwarts her suicide attempt. Noni and Kaz feel an instant attraction, but those in their orbit oppose the romance for fear the pair will stray from the course planned out for both of them. (Drama, Romance) - 2014

shadesofblack.us.title: 4Play
shadesofblack.us.description: Unsatisfied with his prior romantic conquests, a Chicago club owner (Wesley Jonathan) tries to juggle relationships with three women at once. (Drama) - 2014

shadesofblack.us.title: A Haunted House
shadesofblack.us.description: Young couple Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) and Kisha (Essence Atkins) have just moved into their dream home. As they settle in, they learn that they're not alone -- not because the house is haunted, but because Kisha is possessed by a demon. Desperate to salvage his relationship -- and more importantly -- his sex life -- Malcolm hires a coterie of paranormal specialists, which includes a priest and ghostbusters, to banish the unwelcome intruder from Kisha's body. (Comedy, Horror) - 2013

shadesofblack.us.title: A Haunted House 2
shadesofblack.us.description: After the ordeal he suffered with his now former girlfriend's (Essence Atkins) demonic possession, Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) has decided to start fresh. He has a new girlfriend named Megan (Jaime Pressly), and they and Megan's children are moving into their dream home. Soon afterward, Malcolm is once again plagued by supernatural shenanigans -- only this time, it's not just the house that's haunted. A demon has attached itself to Malcolm, and shows no signs of letting go. (Comedy, Horror) - 2014

shadesofblack.us.title: Meet the Blacks
shadesofblack.us.description: When some unexpected money comes his way, Carl Black moves his family from cold and windy Chicago to bright and sunny Beverly Hills, Calif. As the Blacks settle into their beautiful new home, they start to notice some strange behavior in the neighborhood. Nighttime is approaching, and President El bama announces that the annual purge is about to begin. Carl and his loved ones must now endure a 12-hour period of lawlessness before they can enjoy life once again. (Comedy) - 2016

shadesofblack.us.title: The Inspection
shadesofblack.us.description: A young, gay Black man with few options for his future decides to join the Marines, willing to do whatever it takes to prove himself to his estranged mother and triumph in a system that would otherwise cast him aside. However, even as he battles deep-seated prejudice and the grueling rigor of basic training, he finds unexpected camaraderie, strength and support in this new community, giving him a hard-won sense of belonging that shapes his identity and forever changes his life. (Drama, LGBTQ) - 2022

shadesofblack.us.title: Triple Threat
shadesofblack.us.description: A crime syndicate places a hit on a billionaire's daughter, making her the target of an elite assassin squad. A band of down-and-out mercenaries protects her, fighting tooth and nail to stop the assassins from reaching their target. (Action, Martial arts) - 2019

outlaw.us.title: San Antonio
outlaw.us.description: Rancher Clay Hardin (Errol Flynn) has discovered that local saloon owner Roy Stuart (Paul Kelly) is selling cattle that doesn't belong to him, including some of Clay's own stolen stock. Armed with a tally book that proves it, Hardin now finds himself the target of Stuart's posse of gunslingers, who will stop at nothing to prevent Hardin from delivering the evidence to the proper authorities. With no one to help him except a few of his friends, Hardin has to fight for his cattle, and his life. (Western) - 1945

outlaw.us.title: How the West Was Won
outlaw.us.description: Setting off on a journey to the west in the 1830s, the Prescott family run into a man named Linus (James Stewart), who helps them fight off a pack of thieves. Linus then marries daughter Eve Prescott (Carroll Baker), and 30 years later goes off to fight in the Civil War with their son, with bloody results. Eve's sister, Lily (Debbie Reynolds), heads further west and has adventures with a professional gambler (Gregory Peck), stretching all the way to San Francisco and into the 1880s. (Western) - 1962

outlaw.us.title: Riding Shotgun
outlaw.us.description: Larry Delong loses his sister and her son when they're gunned down by the notorious Dan Marady and his band of outlaws during a holdup. Delong takes a job as a stagecoach guard, hoping to run into the bandits and take revenge. Run into them, he does, but numbers are on Marady's side, and they shoot up and rob Delong's coach. Delong barely escapes with his life. When he tries to alert the authorities, they implicate him in the crime, and he becomes a fugitive. (Western) - 1954

outlaw.us.title: Arrow in the Dust
outlaw.us.description: A cavalry deserter (Sterling Hayden) poses as a major and leads a wagon train with a hidden cargo of repeating rifles. (Western) - 1954

outlaw.us.title: Fort Osage
outlaw.us.description: A scout (Rod Cameron) leads a wagon train through territory made hostile by a violated treaty. (Western) - 1952

outlaw.us.title: The First Texan
outlaw.us.description: Having left his post as governor of Tennessee, Gen. Sam Houston (Joel McCrea) resettles in Mexican territory along the southwest U.S. border. He soon sets his sights on reclaiming the land under the aegis of Texas independence, while romancing post-divorce new love interest Katherine Delaney (Felicia Farr). His efforts eventually lead to the historic Battle of San Jacinto and a very clever bit of battlefield strategy by Houston in his fight against forces led by Gen. Santa Anna. (Western) - 1956

outlaw.us.title: They Died With Their Boots On
outlaw.us.description: George Armstrong Custer (Errol Flynn) is a rebellious but ambitious soldier, eager to join the Civil War. During the war, Custer has numerous successes to his credit, even though he disobeys orders. After the war concludes, he marries Libby Bacon (Olivia de Havilland) and is assigned to the Dakota Territory. Custer negotiates honestly with the Sioux on land, but due to corruption from others, a battle with Sitting Bull's forces occurs at Little Big Horn. (Western) - 1941

outlaw.us.title: Riding Shotgun
outlaw.us.description: Larry Delong loses his sister and her son when they're gunned down by the notorious Dan Marady and his band of outlaws during a holdup. Delong takes a job as a stagecoach guard, hoping to run into the bandits and take revenge. Run into them, he does, but numbers are on Marady's side, and they shoot up and rob Delong's coach. Delong barely escapes with his life. When he tries to alert the authorities, they implicate him in the crime, and he becomes a fugitive. (Western) - 1954

outtvproud.us.title: Fatal Beauty
outtvproud.us.description: Detective Rita Rizzoli (Whoopi Goldberg) is accustomed to donning costumes and going undercover to nail crooks. But she'll be required to use all of her get-ups and more when a major cocaine ring is suspected of turning out a potent new strain of the drug, called "Fatal Beauty." With the help of her partner, Jimenez (Ruben Blades), and a former bodyguard for a local cartel (Sam Elliott), Rita will do whatever it takes to find out who's dealing Fatal Beauty and stop them. (Crime drama) - 1987

outtvproud.us.title: D.O.A.: Dead or Alive
outtvproud.us.description: Four beautiful rivals at an invitation-only martial-arts tournament join forces against a sinister threat. Princess Kasumi (Devon Aoki) is an aristocratic warrior trained by martial-arts masters. Tina Armstrong (Jaime Pressly) is a wrestling superstar. Helena Douglas (Sarah Carter) is an athlete with a tragic past. Christie Allen (Holly Valance) earns her keep as a thief and an assassin-for-hire. (Action, Science fiction, Martial arts) - 2006

outtvproud.us.title: True Crime
outtvproud.us.description: Mary (Alicia Silverstone), a precocious high school senior, longs to be a cop. She idolizes her late father, a policeman, and intently studies her favorite magazine, "True Crime." When a classmate dies and the case remains unsolved, Mary becomes obsessed, pestering a local cop (Bill Nunn). When she meets police cadet Tony (Kevin Dillon), the two decide to take up the investigation themselves, and romantic sparks soon fly. But Mary has no idea of the danger that awaits her. (Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery, Horror) - 1995

outtvproud.us.title: Sweet Revenge
outtvproud.us.description: An outfoxed lawyer (Carrie Fisher) hires an actress (Rosanna Arquette) to seduce her ex-husband (John Sessions) by posing as his ideal woman. (Romantic comedy) - 1990

outtvproud.us.title: Mannequin Two: On the Move
outtvproud.us.description: Although Jason (William Ragsdale) works as a department store clerk, he is also a reincarnated prince. Long ago, his beloved Jessie (Kristy Swanson) was snatched away from him by an evil wizard (Terry Kiser) who used his powers to transform her into wooden statue. Now Jessie is in Jason's department store as a mannequin. When he encounters her, she awakens from her thousand-year sleep. They quickly revive their romance, but the evil wizard has been reincarnated as well, and he's up to no good. (Fantasy, Comedy, Romance) - 1991

outtvproud.us.title: Coming Soon
outtvproud.us.description: Privileged teenage friends Jenny (Gaby Hoffmann), Nell (Tricia Vessey) and Stream (Bonnie Root) spend their senior year on a quest to rid Stream of her virginity. However, Stream wants more than just her first sexual experience. She wants to have an orgasm -- but achieving this proves problematic, as the boys she meets are hardly sensitive enough to provide her the release she seeks. When it becomes clear that Nell and Jenny have never experienced an orgasm either, all three set out to get one. (Romantic comedy, LGBTQ) - 1999

outtvproud.us.title: Jackie's Back!
outtvproud.us.description: A British documentarian (Tim Curry) profiles a washed-up diva (Jenifer Lewis) as she prepares for her comeback concert. (Comedy) - 1999

outtvproud.us.title: Cruel Intentions
outtvproud.us.description: Annette (Reese Witherspoon) unwittingly becomes a pawn in Sebastian's (Ryan Phillippe) and Kathryn's (Sarah Michelle Gellar) deliciously diabolical wager of sexual conquest when she writes an article in Seventeen Magazine about how she intends to stay pure until she marries her boyfriend. However, Sebastian gets more than he bargained for as he attempts to woo Annette into his bed. (Drama) - 1999

outtvproud.us.title: Lord of Illusions
outtvproud.us.description: Private eye Harry D'Amour travels to Los Angeles and meets with a new client, Dorothea Swann. Swann reveals that she and her husband — famed magician Philip Swann — have been targeted by a religious cult experimenting with reincarnation. After Philip dies on stage in the midst of a dangerous trick, D'Amour must struggle to protect Dorothea from the ruthless cult members and their newly reanimated religious leader, Nix. (Horror) - 1995

outtvproud.us.title: Troll 2
outtvproud.us.description: When young Joshua (Michael Stephenson) learns that he will be going on vacation with his family to a small town called Nilbog, he protests adamantly. He is warned by the spirit of his deceased grandfather that goblins populate the town. His parents, Michael (George Hardy) and Diana (Margo Prey), dismiss his apprehensions, but soon learn to appreciate their son's warnings. Guided by his grandfather's ghost, will Joshua and his family stand a chance in fighting off these evil beings? (Horror, Comedy) - 1990

outtvproud.us.title: Night of the Comet
outtvproud.us.description: After a rare comet sighting, teen sisters Regina (Catherine Mary Stewart) and Samantha (Kelli Maroney) find that they're among the only survivors of a zombie attack. The girls partner with another survivor, Hector (Robert Beltran), but as they try to avoid the zombies, they're sought by scientists who want to experiment on their bodies in the hope of finding an antidote. Dodging both the doctors and the undead, they keep moving in the hope that they can continue to stay alive. (Science fiction, Comedy, Horror) - 1984

tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E08 The Bushland Treehouse Paul and Trent want to escape their busy lives to a 600-acre conservation property.

tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E05 Scotland's Island Cottage Builder Justin and wife Emma tackle an ambitious modular home build on Scotland's remote North Uist.

tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E01 Dream Island Home After years traveling through Europe, Iain and Alyson are ready to put down roots. Their search takes them to Inner Hebridean Island of Skye where they purchase a remote half acre plot, but building a traditional house is a challenge.

tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E02 Forest Treehouse Delaval and Veronica are restoring 450 acres for conservation and funding it by building a treehouse in Swanton Novers Wood. A Scottish firm constructs it in 7 sections to minimize damage to the woodland habitat on delivery.

tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E06 From Caravan to Dream Home Sarah and Adam swap caravan life for their dream home in rural Cornwall.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E03 A Dream Childhood Home Lauren's childhood home needs big help to become the grown up family home for her, Kyle and their two boys, while real estate agent Odane needs expert staging to help his clients sell high, and buy their dream home.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E05 Townhouse Transformation Nicole and Caffrey transform a townhouse into an absolute dream for Nicole and her two daughters, while helping real estate pro Chris uncover and stage this cluttered suburban listing.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E08 100 Years Newer After going way over time and budget renovating the main floor of their century home, Jake and Lorraine have run out of steam and need Nicole and Caffrey to take on the second floor before their fast-approaching wedding!

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E07 Speakeasy to Me Nicole and Caffery bring all the moody design vibes to their first speakeasy lounge for game enthusiasts Krysti and Dana; while real estate agent Natalie's compact condo listing needs staging help to spark it into a luxe and warm downtown home.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E07 New Generation Style Ashley and Colin can't wait to see how Nicole and Caffrey transform Ashley's grandmother's dated bungalow into their new, modern, family home; and Caffrey gets Nicole on board with giving his good friend Marlene a much-needed refresh of her home.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E04 Builder Basic to Modern Mohit and Kiru need Nicole and Caffrey to bring a 'styled' look to their very empty new home, and Andrea's trusting her first listing to these staging masters.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E06 A Pop of Color Kevin, Aaron, and their kids love their new home, but not the all-beige design. Without any idea of how to start, Nicole and Caffrey will bring in the color! And, Demetres needs to get a home sold that hasn't had any updates in over 30 years.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E06 Suite Retreat Nicole and Caffrey design an executive rental suite to help supplement Vashti's path to retirement, while real estate agent Kelsey pursues Nicole and Caffrey's much-needed staging expertise to help sell her clients' colorful and chaotic townhouse.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E01 Paid Off, Styled Up Finally mortgage-free, Denise is now ready for her main floor to go from bleak to chic. Nicole and Caffery will create a maximalist, welcoming space that reflects her larger than life personality!

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E02 Every Woman's Dream Home Single mom Sony and her teen daughters envision a home that's for the girls - feminine, beautiful, bright and modern. Without a clue of how to make it happen, they're trusting Nicole and Caffery to get it Styled!

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E01 Invest In Your Kitchen Diane and Bernard are downsizing. They're counting on Nicole and Caffrey to get them top dollar! And back in the city, Whitney is struggling to make her townhouse function properly. Nicole and Caffrey bring their magic to transform this townhouse!

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E08 Elevated Oasis With renters in the basement, Sarah and Shawn have nowhere to go but up to find some tranquility. Nicole and Caffrey take on their dated bedroom and ensuite to create an elevated oasis.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E04 Two Sisters, One Home Sisters Leandra and Alayna recently inherited their childhood home. So they've asked Nicole and Caffrey to transform it into a fresh, contemporary space while still honoring the past.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E02 An Elevated Lower Level Nicole and Caffrey design a basement getaway for Sharon, Jason and their growing tweens, creating a space where they'll actually want to hang out. They'll also help real estate pro Haaris get his bungalow listing polished up in a competitive market.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E05 A Modern Home and Rental Chrissy's multipurpose home needs help to be as vibrant as Chrissy and her podcast with Marie, while Raymond has a house to sell that needs staging in a hurry.

universalmovies.us.title: Twins

universalmovies.us.description: A Manhattan hotel concierge (Michael J. Fox) woos the mistress (Gabrielle Anwar) of an investor (Anthony Higgins) he needs for a big business deal.

universalmovies.us.title: Ted 2
universalmovies.us.description: Teddy bear Ted (Seth MacFarlane) seeks legal help from a young lawyer (Amanda Seyfried) and a legendary, civil-rights attorney (Morgan Freeman) when the law declares him to be property and not a person.

universalmovies.us.title: A Million Ways to Die in the West
universalmovies.us.description: A pistol-packing woman (Charlize Theron) helps a cowardly farmer (Seth MacFarlane) find his inner courage, but when her outlaw husband (Liam Neeson) rides into town seeking revenge, the farmer must put his newfound bravery to the test.

universalmovies.us.title: Doomsday
universalmovies.us.description: A commander (Rhona Mitra) and her crew venture into long-quarantined Scotland to find the counteragent to a deadly virus that has re-emerged in London.

universalmovies.us.title: The Purge: Anarchy
universalmovies.us.description: Three groups of people intertwine and are left stranded in the streets on Purge Night, trying to survive the chaos and violence that occurs.

universalmovies.us.title: The Hitcher
universalmovies.us.description: Two traveling students (Sophia Bush, Zachary Knighton) pick up a hitchhiker (Sean Bean), unaware that he is a serial killer who intends to pin his crimes on them.

universalmovies.us.title: Altered
universalmovies.us.description: Fifteen years after they were abducted by aliens, four men get a chance to take revenge when they capture one of the creatures.

universalmovies.us.title: Werewolf: The Beast Among Us
universalmovies.us.description: A mysterious creature terrorizes a village, and Daniel teams up with werewolf hunters to track down the vicious beast. As villagers are attacked one by one and, themselves, turned into beasts, Daniel fears the foe is someone close to them all.

universalmovies.us.title: Hulk
universalmovies.us.description: Bruce Banner, a genetics researcher with a tragic past, suffers an accident that causes him to transform into a raging green monster when he gets angry.

unxplainedzone.us.description: S04 E10 Mysteries of the Missing Link More than 7 billion people live on Earth; human civilizations span the globe; although many around the globe believe that the divine hand of God placed humans on Earth, others question whether there were ever other kinds of human-like creatures.

waypointtv.us.title: Hard Truths Of Conservation : 100 Lions

waypointtv.us.title: Hard Truths Of Conservation : The Bear

classica.us.title: Mahler - Symphonie Nr. 10
classica.us.description: Mahlers 10. Symphonie ist ein unvollendetes Werk, das der Komponist bei seinem Tod hinterließ und das seine letzte emotionale Reise von Qual und Herzschmerz zu einer vorbehaltlosen Akzeptanz des Lebens und der menschlichen Liebe darstellt. (Special) - 2026-04-18

classica.us.title: Bach - Brandenburgischen Konzerte, BWV 1046-1051
classica.us.description: Václav Luks dirigiert das Collegium 1704 in Johann Sebastian Bachs Brandenburgische Konzerte 1-6. Im Jubiläumsjahr 2021 wurden sie im neu restaurierten Spiegelsaal des Köthener Schlosses mit dem Collegium 1704 aufgezeichnet. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2022-02-20

classica.us.title: Teatro Regio - Hinter den Kulissen
classica.us.description: Das Teatro Regio wurde 1740 mit der Aufführung eines Werkes von Francesco Feo eröffnet. Eine Blütezeit erlebte das Haus von 1895 bis 1898 unter der Leitung von Arturo Toscanini. 1896 fand dort die Uraufführung von Puccinis "La Bohème" statt. (Special, Documentary, Music, Classical, Opera) - 2017-06-01

classica.us.title: Bach - Brandenburgisches Konzert Nr. 1
classica.us.description: J. S. Bachs Reihe der sechs Brandenburgischen Konzerte gehört zu seinen bekanntesten Werken. Zu ihrem 300-jährigen Jubiläum im Jahr 2021 spielten Václav Luks und das renommierte Barockensemble Collegium 1704 alle sechs Brandenburgischen Konzerte. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2023-06-04

classica.us.title: Orff: Carmina Burana
classica.us.description: Die von Carl Orff komponierten „Carmina Burana" sind in den Jahren 1935 und 1936 entstanden. Die Kantate basiert auf 24 Gedichten aus der gleichnamigen mittelalterlichen Sammlung, bestehend aus zumeist lateinischen Lied- und Dramentexten. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert, Event) - 2020-01-01

classica.us.title: Mahler - Sinfonie Nr. 9
classica.us.description: Maestro Myung-Whun Chung leitet das Orchester del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino bei einer Aufführung von Gustav Mahlers Symphonie Nr. 9 in D-Dur. Diese Symphonie wurde in den Jahren 1908-1909 geschrieben und war die letzte, die Mahler vollendete. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2024-08-23

classica.us.title: Kammermusik von Mozart und Schostakowitsch
classica.us.description: Der Geiger Renaud Capuçon tritt beim Festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly auf und spielt Kammermusik aus dem klassischen Repertoire und dem Repertoire des 20. Jahrhunderts. Er tritt mit den Solisten der Internationalen Menuhin-Musikakademie auf. (Music) - 2024-12-13

classica.us.title: Schumann - Fantasiestücke, Op.12
classica.us.description: In dieser Aufführung vom Verbier Festival von 2018 zollt Seong-Jin Cho Claude Debussy Tribut anlässlich seines 100. Geburtstags. Auf dem Programm stehen Schumanns Fantasiestücke op. 12, die nur selten in Konzertprogrammen zu hören sind. (Special, Music, Concert) - 2021-05-29

classica.us.title: Beethoven - 3. Sinfonie in Es-Dur, op. 55
classica.us.description: Der Dirigent Fabio Luisi leitet das Dänische Radio-Sinfonieorchester in einer Aufführung von Beethovens 3. Sinfonie in Es-Dur, Op. 55. Neben der fantastischen "Eroica" werden auch Strawinskis Psalmensinfonie und Strauss' "Don Juan" interpretiert. (Special, Entertainment, Music, Concert) - 2020-12-10

classica.us.title: Barbara Hannigan at Severance Hall
classica.us.description: Die Musikerin Barbara Hannigan gewann den Grammy für das beste klassische Solo-Vokalalbum 2018 und wurde 2022 als Künstlerin des Jahres ausgezeichnet. Im Herbst 2023 gab sie ihr lang erwartetes Dirigentendebüt mit dem Cleveland Orchestra. (Special, Music) - 2023-01-01

classica.us.title: Schubert - Rosamunde Ouvertüre (D. 644)
classica.us.description: Andreas Spering dirigiert die Philharmonie Zuidnederland in einer Aufführung in Eindhoven 2015. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2019-09-03

classica.us.title: Mahler - Symphonie Nr. 2
classica.us.description: Mahlers Auferstehungssinfonie, komponiert zwischen 1888 und 1894, ist ein monumentales Werk in fünf Sätzen, das Themen wie Tod und Auferstehung erforscht. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2026-02-07

classica.us.title: Mozarts Sinfonie Nr. 34 und Dvořáks Sinfonie Nr. 7
classica.us.description: Iván Fischer dirigiert das Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in diesem Konzert. Eröffnet wird das Programm mit Mozarts Sinfonie Nr. 34 in C-Dur, KV 338. Diese Sinfonie war die letzte, die Mozart in Salzburg als Hofmusiker schrieb. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2024-10-18

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Klaviersonate Nr. 21 - III
classica.us.description: Julijana Sarac spielt den dritten Satz aus Ludwig van Beethovens Klaviersonate Nr. 21. (Special, Music) - 2023-05-02

classica.us.title: Martha Argerich - Eine Geburtstagsfeier - III
classica.us.description: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags widmet sich die argentinische Pianistin Martha Argerich dem Kammermusikrepertoire in einem wunderbaren Konzert. Die "Grande Dame des Klaviers" wird von verschiedenen renommierten Künstlern begleitet. (Music, Concert, Classical) - 2024-09-21

classica.us.title: Mozart, Mendelssohn und Gershwin für 2 Klaviere
classica.us.description: Zwei italienische Pianisten interpretieren gemeinsam Mozarts Klaviersonate in D für zwei Klaviere, Mendelssohns Klaviersonate für zwei Klaviere in D und Gershwins "Rhapsody in Blue" in einem Konzertprogramm aus dem Fazioli-Saal in Sacile. (Special, Music) - 2021-02-13

classica.us.title: Approaching the Maelstrom
classica.us.description: Der Dokumentarfilm aus dem Jahr 2019 verfolgt den Prozess, der zu einer Aufnahme der Komposition "A Descent into the Maelström" des US-amerikanischen Komponisten Philip Glass führte. Das Werk basiert auf dem Werk des Schriftstellers Edgar Allan Poe. (Documentary, Music) - 2019

classica.us.title: Mahler - Symphonie Nr. 7
classica.us.description: Ungewöhnliche Orchesterfarben und -effekte. Die Verwendung seltenerer Instrumente und die frischen Klanglandschaften, die Mahler schafft, führen zu einem reichen und einzigartigen Hörerlebnis. (Special) - 2026-03-21

classica.us.title: Schumann - 2. Klaviersonate in g-Moll, op. 22
classica.us.description: In dieser Aufführung präsentiert Riccardo Schwartz Schumanns Klaviersonate Nr. 2 in g-Moll, Op. 22. Es beginnt mit einem energischen ersten Satz, gefolgt von einem wunderschönen, langsamen Andantino nach Schumanns Lied "Im Herbste". (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2024-01-09
